            "chunk": "Read text file `app/Controllers/AuthController.php`.\n1|<?php\n2|/**\n3| * AuthController — ONE passwordless login for everyone.\n4| *\n5| * There is a single login page (/login). The user enters any identifier they\n6| * have — email, phone, or account number. We figure out who they are:\n7| *\n8| *   1. Match the identifier against active STAFF first (by email).\n9| *   2. Otherwise match against CUSTOMERS (by email, phone, or account number).\n10| *\n11| * Whoever matches gets a 6-digit code emailed to their address on file. After\n12| * they enter it, we open the right session and send them to the dashboard that\n13| * fits their authority level:\n14| *\n15| *   - staff with role 'admin'  → /admin            (the CMS)\n16| *   - any other staff          → /staff-dashboard  (operations)\n17| *   - customers                → /customer-dashboard (their account)\n18| *\n19| * No passwords exist anywhere; the emailed code IS the credential. The flow is\n20| * timing-safe, single-use, expiry-bound, and brute-force limited (see OtpAuth).\n21| */\n22|\n23|declare(strict_types=1);\n24|\n25|namespace PPC\\Controllers;\n26|\n27|use PPC\\Core\\View;\n28|use PPC\\Core\\Session;\n29|use PPC\\Core\\Csrf;\n30|use PPC\\Core\\Database;\n31|use PPC\\Core\\Logger;\n32|use PPC\\Core\\RateLimiter;\n33|use PPC\\Core\\Validator;\n34|use PPC\\Core\\Config;\n35|use PPC\\Auth\\OtpAuth;\n36|use PPC\\Auth\\Mailer;\n37|\n38|class AuthController extends PageController\n39|{\n40|    /** OTP purpose shared by the unified login (keyed per email). */\n41|    private const PURPOSE = 'login';\n42|    /** OTP purpose for the super-user elevated surface (isolated from standard login). */\n43|    private const SU_PURPOSE = 'super-login';\n44|\n45|    /* ============================ STEP 1: IDENTIFY ============================ */\n46|\n47|    /** The single login form. */\n48|    public function loginForm(): void\n49|    {\n50|        // Already signed in? Send them straight to their dashboard.\n51|        if (Session::authenticated()) {\n52|            header('Location: ' . $this->dashboardFor(Session::userType(), Session::staffRole()));\n53|            exit;\n54|        }\n55|        echo View::page('auth/login', [\n56|            'flash' => Session::pullFlash('auth'),\n57|        ], $this->meta('Sign In | Patriot Pest Control', 'One secure sign-in for customers and staff. No password — we email you a code and send you to the right dashboard.', '/login'));\n58|    }\n59|\n60|    /**\n61|     * Identify the user and email a code. Staff are matched first (by email),\n62|     * then customers (by email/phone/account). The resolved identity + type are\n63|     * remembered in the session for STEP 2.\n64|     */\n65|    public function loginRequest(): void\n66|    {\n67|        Csrf::verifyOrDie();\n68|\n69|        $identifier = trim((string) ($_POST['identifier'] ?? ''));\n70|        $errors = Validator::make(['identifier' => $identifier], ['identifier' => ['required', 'max:120']]);\n71|        if ($errors) {\n72|            Session::flash('auth', ['error' => 'Please enter your email, phone number, or account number.']);\n73|            header('Location: /login');\n74|            exit;\n75|        }\n76|\n77|        // --- Rate limit: 5 attempts per minute per client IP ---\n78|        // Uses X-Forwarded-For behind the reverse proxy (REMOTE_ADDR is the\n79|        // proxy itself there). Per-identity limiting lives in OtpAuth.\n80|        $ip = RateLimiter::clientIp();\n81|        $rateKey = 'login:' . $ip;\n82|        if (RateLimiter::tooMany($rateKey, 5, 60)) {\n83|            $wait = RateLimiter::retryAfter($rateKey, 5, 60);\n84|            Session::flash('auth', ['error' => 'Too many login attempts. Please wait ' . ceil($wait / 60) . ' minute(s) before trying again.']);\n85|            header('Location: /login');\n86|            exit;\n87|        }\n88|        RateLimiter::hit($rateKey, false, $ip);\n89|\n90|        $db   = Database::instance();\n91|        $dest = '/login/verify';\n92|\n93|        // 1) Staff (by email) - staff take priority so an admin email never\n94|        //    accidentally resolves to a customer row.\n95|        // Defense 1: super-user accounts are excluded from the standard login\n96|        // flow. They must use the dedicated /su elevated surface instead.\n97|        $staff = $this->findStaffForLogin($identifier);\n98|        if ($staff !== null) {\n99|            RateLimiter::clear($rateKey);\n100|            $this->issueAndEmail($staff['email'], 'staff');\n101|            Session::put('pending_login_email', $staff['email']);\n102|            Session::put('pending_login_type', 'staff');\n103|            Session::put('pending_login_id', $staff['id']);\n104|            Session::flash('auth', ['sent' => true, 'to' => $this->maskEmail($staff['email'])]);\n105|            header('Location: ' . $dest);\n106|            exit;\n107|        }\n108|\n109|        // 2) Customer (by email, phone, or account number).\n110|        $customer = $db->fetch(\n111|            'SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE email = ? OR phone = ? OR account_number = ? LIMIT 1',\n112|            [$identifier, $identifier, $identifier]\n113|        );\n114|        if ($customer !== null && !empty($customer['email'])) {\n115|            RateLimiter::clear($rateKey);\n116|            $this->issueAndEmail($customer['email'], 'customer');\n117|            Session::put('pending_login_email', $customer['email']);\n118|            Session::put('pending_login_type', 'customer');\n119|            Session::put('pending_login_id', $customer['id']);\n120|            Session::flash('auth', ['sent' => true, 'to' => $this->maskEmail($customer['email'])]);\n121|            header('Location: ' . $dest);\n122|            exit;\n123|        }\n124|\n125|        // No match. Don't reveal whether an account exists (enumeration defense):\n126|        // show the same \"code sent\" screen, but no code was actually issued, so\n127|        // verification will simply fail.\n128|        Session::flash('auth', ['sent' => true, 'to' => $this->maskEmail($identifier)]);\n129|        header('Location: ' . $dest);\n130|        exit;\n131|    }\n132|\n133|    /* ============================ STEP 2: VERIFY ============================ */\n134|\n135|    /** The code-entry form (shared). */\n136|    public function loginVerifyForm(): void\n137|    {\n138|        echo View::page('auth/verify', [\n139|            'purpose' => 'login',\n140|            'action'  => '/login/verify',\n141|            'sentTo'  => Session::pullFlash('auth'),\n142|        ], $this->meta('Enter Your Code | Patriot Pest Control', 'Enter the 6-digit code we emailed you.', '/login/verify'));\n143|    }\n144|\n145|    /** Verify the code, open the right session, route by authority level. */\n146|    public function loginVerify(): void\n147|    {\n148|        Csrf::verifyOrDie();\n149|\n150|        $email = Session::get('pending_login_email');\n151|        $type  = Session::get('pending_login_type');\n152|        $code  = trim((string) ($_POST['code'] ?? ''));\n153|\n154|        if (!$email || !$type || $code === '') {\n155|            Session::flash('auth', ['error' => 'Please start over and request a new code.']);\n156|            header('Location: /login');\n157|            exit;\n158|        }\n159|\n160|        if (!OtpAuth::verify($email, self::PURPOSE, $code)) {\n161|            $wait = OtpAuth::retryAfter($email, self::PURPOSE);\n162|            Session::flash('auth', ['error' => $wait > 0\n163|                ? 'Too many attempts. Try again in about ' . ceil($wait / 60) . ' minute(s).'\n164|                : 'That code is incorrect or has expired. Please try again.']);\n165|            header('Location: /login/verify');\n166|            exit;\n167|        }\n168|\n169|        // Success → build the session for the resolved identity.\n170|        $dest = $type === 'staff'\n171|            ? $this->startStaffSession($email)\n172|            : $this->startCustomerSession($email);\n173|\n174|        // Clear the pending-login state.\n175|        Session::forget('pending_login_email');\n176|        Session::forget('pending_login_type');\n177|        Session::forget('pending_login_id');\n178|\n179|        header('Location: ' . $dest);\n180|        exit;\n181|    }\n182|\n183|    /* ============================== LOGOUT ============================== */\n184|\n185|    /** One logout for everyone. */\n186|    public function logout(): void\n187|    {\n188|        $this->audit('logout', Session::userType() ?? 'guest', Session::get('user_id'));\n189|        Session::destroy();\n190|        header('Location: /');\n191|        exit;\n192|    }\n193|\n194|    /* ============================== HELPERS ============================== */\n195|\n196|    /** Issue a code and email it (dev mode logs it to storage/logs/mail-*.log). */\n197|    /** Issue a code and email it (dev mode logs it to storage/logs/mail-*.log). */\n198|    private function issueAndEmail(string $email, string $who): void\n199|    {\n200|        // --- Rate limit: 3 codes per identity per 5 minutes ---\n201|        $limitKey = 'otp_issue:' . $email;\n202|        if (RateLimiter::tooMany($limitKey, 3, 300)) {\n203|            $wait = RateLimiter::retryAfter($limitKey, 3, 300);\n204|            Session::flash('auth', ['error' => 'Too many code requests. Please wait ' . ceil($wait / 60) . ' minute(s) before requesting another.']);\n205|            header('Location: /login');\n206|            exit;\n207|        }\n208|        RateLimiter::hit($limitKey, false);\n209|\n210|        $code = OtpAuth::issue($email, self::PURPOSE);\n211|        $mins = (int) (Config::int('OTP_TTL', 600) / 60);\n212|        Mailer::send(\n213|            $email,\n214|            'Your Patriot Pest Control sign-in code',\n215|            Mailer::template(\n216|                'Your sign-in code',\n217|                '<p style=\"font-size:32px;letter-spacing:8px;font-weight:bold;color:#c8a24a\">' . $code . '</p>'\n218|                . '<p>This code expires in ' . $mins . ' minutes and works once. If you didn\\'t request it, you can safely ignore this email.</p>'\n219|            )\n220|        );\n221|    }\n222|\n223|    /** Build a staff session; return the dashboard they should land on. */\n224|    private function startStaffSession(string $email): string\n225|    {\n226|        $db    = Database::instance();\n227|        $staff = $db->fetch('SELECT id, email, name, role FROM staff WHERE email = ? AND active = 1', [$email]);\n228|        if ($staff === null) {\n229|            Session::flash('auth', ['error' => 'This account is no longer active.']);\n230|            return '/login';\n231|        }\n232|\n233|        // Defense 2: fail-closed — super-user must authenticate via the\n234|        // dedicated /su surface. Standard /login is not a path to /admin\n235|        // for the elevated role.\n236|        if (($staff['role'] ?? '') === 'super-user') {\n237|            Logger::critical('Super-user attempted standard login (blocked)', ['email' => $email]);\n238|            throw new \\RuntimeException('Super-user accounts must use the dedicated /su login surface.');\n239|        }\n240|\n241|        Session::regenerate();                       // new id (fixation defense)\n242|        Session::put('user_id', $staff['id']);\n243|        Session::put('user_type', 'staff');\n244|        Session::put('staff_id', $staff['id']);\n245|        Session::put('staff_role', $staff['role']);\n246|        Session::put('display_name', $staff['name']);\n247|        Session::put('_last_activity', time());\n248|\n249|        $db->execute(\"UPDATE staff SET last_login = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?\", [$staff['id']]);\n250|        $this->audit('login', 'staff', $staff['id'], ['role' => $staff['role']]);\n251|        Logger::info('Staff logged in', ['email' => $email, 'role' => $staff['role']]);\n252|        Session::flash('analytics_event', 'portal_login');\n253|\n254|        return $this->dashboardFor('staff', $staff['role']);\n255|    }\n256|\n257|    /** Build a customer session; return their dashboard. */\n258|    private function startCustomerSession(string $email): string\n259|    {\n260|        $db       = Database::instance();\n261|        $customer = $db->fetch('SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE email = ?', [$email]);\n262|\n263|        Session::regenerate();\n264|        Session::put('user_id', $customer['id'] ?? null);\n265|        Session::put('user_type', 'customer');\n266|        Session::put('display_name', $customer['name'] ?? 'Customer');\n267|        Session::put('customer_email', $email);\n268|        Session::put('_last_activity', time());\n269|\n270|        $this->audit('login', 'customer', $customer['id'] ?? null);\n271|        Logger::info('Customer logged in', ['email' => $email]);\n272|        Session::flash('analytics_event', 'portal_login');\n273|\n274|        return $this->dashboardFor('customer', null);\n275|    }\n276|\n277|    /**\n278|     * The dashboard for a given authority level:\n279|     *   admin staff → CMS; other staff → staff dashboard; customer → portal.\n280|     */\n281|    private function dashboardFor(?string $userType, ?string $role): string\n282|    {\n283|        if ($userType === 'staff') {\n284|            return ($role === 'admin' || $role === 'super-user') ? '/admin' : '/staff-dashboard';\n285|        }\n286|        return '/customer-dashboard';\n287|    }\n288|\n289|    /**\n290|     * Testable seam: staff lookup with super-user exclusion for standard login.\n291|     * Used by loginRequest(); extracted so tests can verify the exclusion clause.\n292|     */\n293|    protected function findStaffForLogin(string $email): ?array\n294|    {\n295|        return Database::instance()->fetch(\n296|            \"SELECT id, email, name, role FROM staff WHERE email = ? AND active = 1 AND role != 'super-user'\",\n297|            [$email]\n298|        );\n299|    }\n300|\n(more lines below)",

AND created_at > ? AND success = 0',\n35|            [$key, $since]\n36|        );\n37|        return $count >= $maxAttempts;\n38|    }\n39|\n40|    /**\n41|     * Best-effort real client IP. ''));\n49|        if ($xff !== '') {\n50|            $first = trim(explode(',', $xff)[0] ?? '');\n51|            if ($first !== '') {\n52|                return $first;\n53|            }\n54|        }\n55|        return $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0';\n56|    }\n57|\n58|    /**\n59|     * Record an attempt for $key.\n60|     *\n61|     * @param string $key     Identifier.\n62|     * @param bool   $success Whether the attempt succeeded.\n63|     * @param string|null $ip Client IP (for correlation/auditing).\n64|     */\n65|    public static function hit(string $key, bool $success = false, ?string $ip = null): void\n66|    {\n67|        try {\n68|            Database::instance()->insert('login_attempts', [\n69|                'identity'   => $key,\n70|                'ip'         => $ip ?? self::clientIp(),\n71|                'user_agent' => mb_substr($_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ?? '', 0, 255),\n72|                'success'    => $success ? 1 : 0,\n73|                'created_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),\n74|            ]);\n75|        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n76|            // Rate limiting must never break the request; log and continue.\n77|            Logger::warning('RateLimiter hit failed', ['key' => $key, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);\n78|        }\n79|    }\n80|\n81|    /**\n82|     * Clear recorded failures for $key (called after a successful auth).\n83|     */\n84|    public static function clear(string $key): void\n85|    {\n86|        try {\n87|            Database::instance()->execute('DELETE FROM login_attempts WHERE identity = ? AND success = 0', [$key]);\n88|        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n89|            Logger::warning('RateLimiter clear failed', ['key' => $key]);\n90|        }\n91|    }\n92|\n93|    /**\n94|     * Seconds until $key is allowed to retry (0 if not locked).\n95|     */\n96|    public static function retryAfter(string $key, int $maxAttempts = 5, int $window = 900): int\n97|    {\n98|        if (!self::tooMany($key, $maxAttempts, $window)) {\n99|            return 0;\n100|        }\n101|        $db   = Database::instance();\n102|        $last = $db->scalar(\n103|            'SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM login_attempts WHERE identity = ? AND success = 0',\n104|            [$key]\n105|        );\n106|        if (!$last) {\n107|            return 0;\n108|        }\n109|        $unlock = strtotime((string) $last) + $window;\n110|        return max(0, $unlock - time());\n111|    }\n112|\n113|    public static function checkOrDie(string $key, int $maxAttempts, int $window): void\n114|    {\n115|        self::hit($key);\n116|        if (self::tooMany($key, $maxAttempts, $window)) {\n117|            throw new RuntimeException(\"Rate limit exceeded for \" . $key);\n118|        }\n119|    }\n120|}",

Localization is a nicety, never a dependency.\n19| */\n20|\n21|declare(strict_types=1);\n22|\n23|namespace PPC\\Core;\n24|\n25|final class Geo\n26|{\n27|    /** The two phone regions and their lines. Returns the new raw key.\n183|     */\n184|    public static function rotateKey(int $keyId, int $byStaffId): ?string\n185|    {\n186|        $db = Database::instance();\n187|        $old = $db->fetch('SELECT id, name, scopes, revoked_at FROM api_keys WHERE id = ?', [$keyId]);\n188|        if (!$old || $old['revoked_at'] !== null) {\n189|            return null;\n190|        }\n191|\n192|        $db->begin();\n193|        try {\n194|            // Revoke old key.\n195|            $db->update('api_keys', ['revoked_at' => gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s')], ['id' => $keyId]);\n196|\n197|            // Create new key with same name + scopes.\n198|            $scopes = json_decode($old['scopes'] ?? '';\n232|        if ($header === '') {\n233|            // Also check Apache-style getallheaders().\n234|            if (function_exists('getallheaders')) {\n235|                $all = getallheaders();\n236|                $header = $all['Authorization'] ?? $all['authorization'] ?? This limiter counts recent attempts per\n7| * key (email/phone and/or IP) in the login_attempts table and blocks once a\n8| * threshold is crossed within a time window.\n9| *\n10| * Usage:\n11| *   if (RateLimiter::tooMany(\"otp:$email\", 5, 900)) { show lockout; }\n12| *   RateLimiter::hit(\"otp:$email\", $ip, false);   // record a failed try\n13| *   RateLimiter::clear(\"otp:$email\");             // on success\n14| */\n15|\n16|declare(strict_types=1);\n17|\n18|namespace PPC\\Core;\n19|\n20|final class RateLimiter\n21|{\n22|    /**\n23|     * Has $key exceeded $maxAttempts within the last $window seconds?\n24|     *\n25|     * @param string $key         Identifier being limited (e.g. \"otp:user@x.com\").\n26|     * @param int    $maxAttempts Allowed attempts in the window.\n27|     * @param int    $window      Window length in seconds.\n28|     */\n29|    public static function tooMany(string $key, int $maxAttempts = 5, int $window = 900): bool\n30|    {\n31|        $db    = Database::instance();\n32|        $since = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - $window);\n33|        $count = (int) $db->scalar(\n34|            'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_attempts WHERE identity = ? AND created_at > ? AND success = 0',\n35|            [$key, $since]\n36|        );\n37|        return $count >= $maxAttempts;\n38|    }\n39|\n40|    /**\n41|     * Best-effort real client IP. Trust the leftmost X-Forwarded-For entry the proxy\n44|     * appends; fall back to REMOTE_ADDR when no proxy header exists.\n45|     */\n46|    public static function clientIp(): string\n47|    {\n48|        $xff = trim((string) ($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] ?? ''));\n49|        if ($xff !== '') {\n50|            $first = trim(explode(',', $xff)[0] ?? '');\n51|            if ($first !== '') {\n52|                return $first;\n53|            }\n54|        }\n55|        return $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0';\n56|    }\n57|\n58|    /**\n59|     * Record an attempt for $key.\n60|     *\n61|     * @param string $key     Identifier.\n62|     * @param bool   $success Whether the attempt succeeded.\n63|     * @param string|null $ip Client IP (for correlation/auditing).\n64|     */\n65|    public static function hit(string $key, bool $success = false, ?string $ip = null): void\n66|    {\n67|        try {\n68|            Database::instance()->insert('login_attempts', [\n69|                'identity'   => $key,\n70|                'ip'         => $ip ?? self::clientIp(),\n71|                'user_agent' => mb_substr($_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ?? AND success = 0', [$key]);\n88|        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n89|            Logger::warning('RateLimiter clear failed', ['key' => $key]);\n90|        }\n91|    }\n92|\n93|    /**\n94|     * Seconds until $key is allowed to retry (0 if not locked).\n95|     */\n96|    public static function retryAfter(string $key, int $maxAttempts = 5, int $window = 900): int\n97|    {\n98|        if (!self::tooMany($key, $maxAttempts, $window)) {\n99|            return 0;\n100|        }\n101|        $db   = Database::instance();\n102|        $last = $db->scalar(\n103|            'SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM login_attempts WHERE identity = ? ''),\\r\\n                    'customer_id' => (int) $row['id'],\\r\\n                ];\\r\\n            }\\r\\n        }\\r\\n        if ($emails !== []) {\\r\\n            $row = $db->fetch(\\r\\n                'SELECT id, name, dnc_reason FROM customers\\r\\n                 WHERE is_no_call = 1 AND email = ? COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 1',\\r\\n                [$emails[0]]\\r\\n            );\\r\\n            if ($row !== null) {\\r\\n                return [\\r\\n\",\n  \"original_output_bytes\": 7870,\n  \"original_output_tokens\": 1968,\n  \"truncated\": false\n}",

All requests flow through public/index.php → Router::dispatch().\n7| *\n8| * Features:\n9| *   - GET/POST registration with {param} placeholders,\n10| *   - chainable per-route guards: ->auth('staff'|'customer'|'*')->role('admin'),\n11| *   - handlers are closures or [Controller::class, 'method'],\n12| *   - clean 404 for anything unmatched.\n13| *\n14| * Example:\n15| *   Router::get('/pest/{slug}', [PestController::class, 'show']);\n16| *   Router::post('/admin/posts', [PostController::class, 'store'])->auth('staff')->role('admin');\n17| */\n18|\n19|declare(strict_types=1);\n20|\n21|namespace PPC\\Core;\n22|\n23|/**\n24| * A single registered route. // required staff role\n31|    /** @var string[] Extra permissions required on top of role (e.g. 'view_customers'). */\n32|    public array $permissions = [];\n33|\n34|    public function __construct(\n35|        public string $method,\n36|        public string $regex,\n37|        public array $params,\n38|        public mixed $handler,\n39|    ) {}\n40|\n41|    /** Require an authenticated user of $type ('*' for any). */\n42|    public function auth(string $type = '*'): self\n43|    {\n44|        $this->auth = $type;\n45|        return $this;\n46|    }\n47|\n48|    /** Require a specific staff role (admin routes also allow Session::isAdmin()). */\n49|    public function role(string $role): self\n50|    {\n51|        $this->role = $role;\n52|        return $this;\n53|    }\n54|\n55|    /**\n56|     * Require one or more specific permissions beyond role.\n57|     * Admin users bypass all permission checks.\n58|     */\n59|    public function permission(string ...$perms): self\n60|    {\n61|        $this->permissions = array_merge($this->permissions, $perms);\n62|        return $this;\n63|    }\n64|}\n65|\n66|final class Router\n67|{\n68|    /** @var Route[] */\n69|    private static array $routes = [];\n70|\n71|    /** Register a GET route; '>[^/]+)';\n90|        }, $pattern);\n91|\n92|        $route = new Route($method, '#^' . $regex . ($_SESSION['staff_role'] ?? null) : null;\n160|    }\n161|\n162|    /** True if the current staff user is an admin or super-user. */\n163|    public static function isSuperUser(): bool\n164|    {\n165|        return self::staffRole() === 'super-user';\n166|    }\n167|\n168|    /** True if the current staff user is an admin or super-user. */\n169|    public static function isAdmin(): bool\n170|    {\n171|        $role = self::staffRole();\n172|        return $role === 'admin' || $role === 'super-user';\n173|    }\n174|\n175|    /**\n176|     * Check whether the current staff user has a specific permission.\n177|     * Admins always return true (they have \"all\"). Otherwise, the staff\n178|     * record's role is looked up in the roles table and the permissions\n179|     * JSON column is checked. Returns false for non-staff users.\n180|     */\n181|    public static function hasPermission(string $permission): bool\n182|    {\n183|        if (self::isAdmin()) {\n184|            return true;\n185|        }\n186|        if (self::userType() !== 'staff') {\n187|            return false;\n188|        }\n189|        $roleName = self::staffRole();\n190|        if ($roleName === null) {\n191|            return false;\n192|        }\n193|        // Look up the role permissions from the DB.\n194|        try {\n195|            $db   = \\PPC\\Core\\Database::instance();\n196|            $role = $db->fetch('SELECT permissions FROM roles WHERE role = ?', [$roleName]);\n197|            if (!$role) {\n198|                return false;\n199|            }\n200|            $perms = json_decode($role['permissions'], true);\n201|            if (!is_array($perms)) {\n202|                return false;\n203|            }\n204|            return in_array('all', $perms, true) || in_array($permission, $perms, true);\n205|        } catch (\\Throwable) {\n206|            return false;\n207|        }\n208|    }\n209|}",

          "event": {
            "chunk": "Read text file `app/Core/Settings.php`.\n1|<?php\n2|/**\n3| * Settings - global site toggles backed by the site_settings table.\n4| *\n5| * Provides cached typed reads plus a write path for the admin CMS. Keys used:\n6| *   egg_enabled   ('1'|'0')  the $25 easter egg beacon on the marketing site\n7| *   track_enabled ('1'|'0')  first-party retention beacon + dashboard\n8| *\n9| * Reads are cached per request so layouts can call bool() freely.\n10| */\n11|\n12|declare(strict_types=1);\n13|\n14|namespace PPC\\Core;\n15|\n16|final class Settings\n17|{\n18|    /** @var array<string,string>|null Cached key/value map. */\n19|    private static ?array $cache = null;\n20|\n21|    /** Load the settings table into the request cache (once). */\n22|    public static function all(): array\n23|    {\n24|        if (self::$cache === null) {\n25|            self::$cache = [];\n26|            foreach (Database::instance()->fetchAll('SELECT key, value FROM site_settings') as $row) {\n27|                self::$cache[(string) $row['key']] = (string) $row['value'];\n28|            }\n29|        }\n30|        return self::$cache;\n31|    }\n32|\n33|    /** Typed boolean read with a sane default for missing keys. */\n34|    public static function bool(string $key, bool $default = true): bool\n35|    {\n36|        $v = self::all()[$key] ?? null;\n37|        if ($v === null) {\n38|            return $default;\n39|        }\n40|        return in_array(strtolower($v), ['1', 'true', 'yes', 'on'], true);\n41|    }\n42|\n43|    /** Upsert a setting and drop the cache so the next read is fresh. */\n44|    public static function set(string $key, string $value): void\n45|    {\n46|        Database::instance()->execute(\n47|            \"INSERT INTO site_settings (key, value, updated_at)\n48|             VALUES (?, ?, datetime('now'))\n49|             ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value, updated_at = datetime('now')\",\n50|            [$key, $value]\n51|        );\n52|        self::$cache = null;\n53|    }\n54|}",

AND to_type = \"customer\" ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5', [(string) $customerId]) : [];\n32|\n33|        // Appointments: try FR live first, fall back to local cache.\n34|        $appointments = [];\n35|        $subscriptions = [];\n36|        $frData = ['configured' => false, 'linked' => false, 'error' => null];\n37|        if ($customer && !empty($customer['fr_id'])) {\n38|            // Try live FR for appointments (subscriptions use local DB due to scoping bug).\n39|            $dist = \\PPC\\Integrations\\FieldRoutes::districtByCode((string) ($customer['district'] ?? ORDER BY scheduled DESC LIMIT 10', [(string) $customerId]);\n56|            }\n57|        }\n58|\n59|        // Billing: local cache only (no payment processing in-app yet).\n60|        $paymentMethods = $customerId ? $db->fetchAll('SELECT * FROM payment_methods WHERE customer_id = ?', [(string) $customerId]) : [];\n61|        $invoices = $customerId ? $db->fetchAll('SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = ? ORDER BY due_date DESC LIMIT 10', [(string) $customerId]) : [];\n62|        $payments = $customerId ? $db->fetchAll('SELECT * FROM payments WHERE customer_id = ? ORDER BY payment_date DESC LIMIT 10', [(string) $customerId]) : [];\n63|\n64|        echo View::page('dashboard/customer', [\n65|            'customer'        => $customer,\n66|            'tickets'         => $tickets,\n67|            'messages'        => $messages,\n68|            'appointments'    => $appointments,\n69|            'subscriptions'   => $subscriptions,\n70|            'paymentMethods'  => $paymentMethods,\n71|            'invoices'        => $invoices,\n72|            'payments'        => $payments,\n73|            'frData'          => $frData,\n74|            'name'            => Session::get('display_name', 'Customer'),\n75|        ], $this->meta('My Account | Patriot Pest Control', 'Your Patriot Pest Control account dashboard.', '/customer-dashboard'));\n76|    }\n77|}",

            "chunk": "Read text file `app/Controllers/PestController.php`.\n1|<?php\n2|/**\n3| * PestController - individual pest \"threat file\" pages.\n4| *\n5| * Fully DB-driven off the pest_photos library: any pest added to the library\n6| * automatically gets a page at /pest/{slug}. Uses the unified pest template so\n7| * every page has the same tactical photo treatment, signs, treatment, and\n8| * prevention structure (good for SEO: consistent, extractable answers).\n9| */\n10|\n11|declare(strict_types=1);\n12|\n13|namespace PPC\\Controllers;\n14|\n15|use PPC\\Core\\Database;\n16|use PPC\\Core\\Router;\n17|use PPC\\Core\\View;\n18|\n19|class PestController extends PageController\n20|{\n21|    /**\n22|     * Render a pest page by slug.\n23|     */\n24|    public function show(string $slug): void\n25|    {\n26|        $db   = Database::instance();\n27|        $pest = $db->fetch('SELECT * FROM pest_photos WHERE slug = ?', [$slug]);\n28|        if ($pest === null) {\n29|            Router::notFound();\n30|        }\n31|\n32|        // Related pests (same category first, then others) for cross-linking.\n33|        $related = $db->fetchAll(\n34|            'SELECT slug, name, filename FROM pest_photos WHERE slug != ? ORDER BY (category = ?) DESC, name LIMIT 6',\n35|            [$slug, $pest['category']]\n36|        );\n37|\n38|        $meta = $this->meta(\n39|            \"{$pest['name']} Control Across 4 States | Patriot Pest Control\",\n40|            ($pest['description'] ?? \"Professional {$pest['name']} control\") . ' Veteran-owned, eco-friendly, 90-day warranty across WA, ID, OR, AZ.',\n41|            \"/pest/{$pest['slug']}\",\n42|            [\n43|                'crumb'  => [['Home', '/'], ['Services', '/services'], [$pest['name'], \"/pest/{$pest['slug']}\"]],\n44|                'jsonld' => [$this->ldBusiness(), $this->ldService($pest)],\n45|            ]\n46|        );\n47|\n48|        echo View::page('pages/pest', [\n49|            'pest'    => $pest,\n50|            'related' => $related,\n51|        ], $meta);\n52|    }\n53|\n54|    /** Service JSON-LD for this specific pest (areaServed + provider). */\n55|    private function ldService(array $pest): array\n56|    {\n57|        return [\n58|            '@context'    => 'https://schema.org',\n59|            '@type'       => 'Service',\n60|            'name'        => \"{$pest['name']} Control\",\n61|            'serviceType' => \"{$pest['name']} Control\",\n62|            'description' => $pest['description'] ??             "chunk": "Read text file `app/Auth/OtpAuth.php`.\n1|<?php\n2|/**\n3| * OtpAuth - passwordless one-time-code authentication.\n4| *\n5| * This is the heart of the login system (no passwords anywhere):\n6| *   1. issue()  - generate a 6-digit code, store a HASH of it (never plaintext),\n7| *                 with expiry + single-use flag, and return the plaintext code\n8| *                 so the caller can email/text it.\n9| *   2. verify() - constant-time compare against the stored hash, enforcing:\n10| *                 expiry, single-use, and a brute-force attempt cap (via\n11| *                 RateLimiter). On success the code is consumed.\n12| *\n13| * Security properties (vs. the old implementation):\n14| *   - codes are hashed with password_hash() at rest,\n15| *   - attempts are counted and lock out after OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS,\n16| *   - codes expire after OTP_TTL seconds,\n17| *   - verification uses hash_equals() (timing-safe),\n18| *   - each code is single-use (used_at set on success).\n19| */\n20|\n21|declare(strict_types=1);\n22|\n23|namespace PPC\\Auth;\n24|\n25|use PPC\\Core\\Config;\n26|use PPC\\Core\\Database;\n27|use PPC\\Core\\Logger;\n28|use PPC\\Core\\RateLimiter;\n29|\n30|final class OtpAuth\n31|{\n32|    /**\n33|     * Issue a new code for $identity. Invalidates any prior unused codes for\n34|     * the same identity+purpose (so only the latest works).\n35|     *\n36|     * @param string $identity Email or phone the code is bound to.\n37|     * @param string $purpose  e.g. 'staff_login', 'customer_login', 'sms_verify'.\n38|     * @return string The plaintext 6-digit code (hand this to the Mailer/SMS).\n39|     */\n40|    public static function issue(string $identity, string $purpose, int $length = 6): string\n41|    {\n42|        $db  = Database::instance();\n43|        $ttl = self::ttlFor($purpose);\n44|\n45|        // Invalidate older unused codes for this identity+purpose.\n46|        $db->execute(\n47|            \"UPDATE otp_codes SET used_at = datetime('now')\n48|             WHERE identity = ? AND purpose = ? AND used_at IS NULL\",\n49|            [$identity, $purpose]\n50|        );\n51|\n52|        // Cryptographically random N-digit code ($length defaults to 6 for backward compat).\n53|        $min = 10 ** ($length - 1);\n54|        $max = (10 ** $length) - 1;\n55|        $code = (string) random_int($min, $max);\n56|\n57|        $db->insert('otp_codes', [\n58|            'identity'   => $identity,\n59|            'purpose'    => $purpose,\n60|            'code_hash'  => password_hash($code, PASSWORD_DEFAULT),\n61|            'attempts'   => 0,\n62|            'expires_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + $ttl),\n63|            'ip'         => RateLimiter::clientIp(),\n64|            'created_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),\n65|        ]);\n66|\n67|        Logger::info('OTP issued', ['identity' => $identity, 'purpose' => $purpose, 'ttl' => $ttl]);\n68|        return $code;\n69|    }\n70|\n71|    /**\n72|     * Verify a submitted code. Returns true only if it matches an unexpired,\n73|     * unused code AND the identity isn't rate-limited. Consumes the code on\n74|     * success and clears the rate-limit counter.\n75|     *\n76|     * @param string $identity Email/phone the code was issued to.\n77|     * @param string $purpose  Must match the purpose it was issued for.\n78|     * @param string $code     The user-submitted code.\n79|     */\n80|    public static function verify(string $identity, string $purpose, string $code): bool\n81|    {\n82|        $db          = Database::instance();\n83|        $maxAttempts = self::maxAttemptsFor($purpose);\n84|        $window      = self::ttlFor($purpose);\n85|        $limitKey    = \"otp:$purpose:$identity\";\n86|\n87|        // Brute-force guard: too many recent failures → reject outright.\n88|        if (RateLimiter::tooMany($limitKey, $maxAttempts, $window)) {\n89|            Logger::warning('OTP verify blocked by rate limit', ['identity' => $identity, 'purpose' => $purpose]);\n90|            return false;\n91|        }\n92|\n93|        // Find the latest unused, unexpired code for this identity+purpose.\n94|        $row = $db->fetch(\n95|            \"SELECT id, code_hash, attempts FROM otp_codes\n96|             WHERE identity = ? AND purpose = ? AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > datetime('now')\n97|             ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1\",\n98|            [$identity, $purpose]\n99|        );\n100|\n101|        if ($row === null) {\n102|            RateLimiter::hit($limitKey, false);\n103|            return false;\n104|        }\n105|\n106|        // Timing-safe comparison against the stored hash.\n107|        $ok = password_verify($code, $row['code_hash']);\n108|\n109|        if (!$ok) {\n110|            // Count the miss (both on the row and the rate limiter).\n111|            $db->execute('UPDATE otp_codes SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = ?', [$row['id']]);\n112|            RateLimiter::hit($limitKey, false);\n113|            Logger::warning('OTP verify failed', ['identity' => $identity, 'purpose' => $purpose]);\n114|            return false;\n115|        }\n116|\n117|        // Success: consume the code (single-use) and clear the limiter.\n118|        $db->execute(\"UPDATE otp_codes SET used_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?\", [$row['id']]);\n119|        RateLimiter::clear($limitKey);\n120|        RateLimiter::hit($limitKey, true); // record the success for audit\n121|        Logger::info('OTP verified', ['identity' => $identity, 'purpose' => $purpose]);\n122|        return true;\n123|    }\n124|\n125|    /**\n126|     * Seconds remaining before a locked-out identity can retry (0 = not locked).\n127|     */\n128|    public static function retryAfter(string $identity, string $purpose): int\n129|    {\n130|        $maxAttempts = self::maxAttemptsFor($purpose);\n131|        $window      = self::ttlFor($purpose);\n132|        return RateLimiter::retryAfter(\"otp:$purpose:$identity\", $maxAttempts, $window);\n133|    }\n134|\n135|    /**\n136|     * TTL (seconds) for a given purpose.\n137|     * 'super-login' -> SU_OTP_TTL (default 300); everything else -> OTP_TTL (default 600).\n138|     */\n139|    public static function ttlFor(string $purpose): int\n140|    {\n141|        if ($purpose === 'super-login') {\n142|            return Config::int('SU_OTP_TTL', 300);\n143|        }\n144|        return Config::int('OTP_TTL', 600);\n145|    }\n146|\n147|    /**\n148|     * Max verify attempts for a given purpose.\n149|     * 'super-login' -> SU_OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3); everything else -> OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 5).\n150|     */\n151|    public static function maxAttemptsFor(string $purpose): int\n152|    {\n153|        if ($purpose === 'super-login') {\n154|            return Config::int('SU_OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS', 3);\n155|        }\n156|        return Config::int('OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS', 5);\n157|    }\n158|}",

monitoring\n10| *\n11| * All routes guarded ->auth('staff')->role('admin').\n12| */\n13|\n14|declare(strict_types=1);\n15|\n16|namespace PPC\\Controllers;\n17|\n18|use PPC\\Core\\View;\n19|use PPC\\Core\\Session;\n20|use PPC\\Core\\Database;\n21|use PPC\\Core\\Csrf;\n22|use PPC\\Core\\Validator;\n23|use PPC\\Integrations\\Twilio;\n24|\n25|class TwilioController extends PageController\n26|{\n27|    /** Twilio admin home: overview and quick stats. */\n28|    public function index(): void\n29|    {\n30|        $db = Database::instance();\n31|        $stats = [\n32|            'sms_total'       => (int) $db->scalar('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sms_logs'),\n33|            'sms_pending'     => (int) $db->scalar(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sms_logs WHERE status = 'queued'\"),\n34|            'calls_total'     => (int) $db->scalar('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM call_logs'),\n35|            'calls_active'    => (int) $db->scalar(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM call_logs WHERE status IN $db->scalar(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM webhook_events WHERE processed = 0\"),\n40|        ];\n41|        echo View::page('admin/twilio/index', ['stats' => $stats, 'flash' => $this->flash()],             "chunk": "Read text file `app/Controllers/WebhookController.php`.\n1|<?php\n2|/**\n3| * WebhookController - Twilio webhook receiver + public unsubscribe endpoint.\n4| *\n5| * All Twilio webhook POSTs land here. Every handler FIRST validates the\n6| * X-Twilio-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical URL+params with the\n7| * auth token) and rejects unsigned/spoofed payloads with 401. This closes the\n8| * spoofed-webhook vector that the original audit flagged.\n9| *\n10| * Endpoints:\n11| *   POST /webhooks/twilio/sms       inbound SMS + STOP keyword handling\n12| *   POST /webhooks/twilio/status    delivery status updates\n13| *   POST /webhooks/twilio/voice     call status updates\n14| *   POST /webhooks/twilio/voicemail voicemail delivery\n15| *   GET  /unsubscribe?token=...     one-click opt-out (CSRF-exempt by design:\n16| *                                   the HMAC-signed token IS the consent proof)\n17| *\n18| * Webhook events are stored in webhook_events (audit) and processed through\n19| * Twilio::processPendingWebhooks() so the existing processing pipeline owns\n20| * the domain logic.\n21| */\n22|\n23|declare(strict_types=1);\n24|\n25|namespace PPC\\Controllers;\n26|\n27|use PPC\\Core\\Config;\n28|use PPC\\Core\\Compliance;\n29|use PPC\\Core\\Logger;\n30|use PPC\\Integrations\\Twilio;\n31|\n32|class WebhookController\n33|{\n34|    /** CTIA STOP keywords. Twilio auto-replies at the platform level; we record the opt-out locally. */\n35|    private const STOP_KEYWORDS = ['STOP', 'STOPALL', 'STOP ALL', 'UNSUBSCRIBE', 'CANCEL', 'END', 'QUIT'];\n36|\n37|    /** Re-subscribe keywords: clear a STOP-derived opt-out. */\n38|    private const START_KEYWORDS = ['START', 'UNSTOP', 'YES'];\n39|\n40|    /**\n41|     * Validate the X-Twilio-Signature header per Twilio's published scheme:\n42|     * base64(HMAC-SHA256(authToken, canonicalUrl + sortedParams)).\n43|     * Rejects the request (401) when missing or mismatched.\n44|     */\n45|    private function requireValidSignature(): void\n46|    {\n47|        // Scheme detection must match the URL Twilio POSTs to. Behind the\n48|        // Dokploy TLS terminator, nginx maps X-Forwarded-Proto to HTTPS.\n49|        $fwdProto = strtolower((string) ($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO'] ?? ''));\n50|        $isHttps  = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off') || $fwdProto === 'https';\n51|        $scheme    = $isHttps ? 'https' : 'http';\n52|        $host      = (string) ($_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? '');\n53|        $requestUri = (string) ($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/');\n54|        $url       = $scheme . '://' . $host . $requestUri;\n55|\n56|        $signature = (string) ($_SERVER['HTTP_X_TWILIO_SIGNATURE'] ?? '');\n57|        $params    = $_POST !== [] ? $_POST : $_GET;\n58|        ksort($params);\n59|\n60|        $data = $url;\n61|        foreach ($params as $key => $value) {\n62|            if (is_array($value)) {\n63|                continue; // flat form fields only; arrays cannot be signed\n64|            }\n65|            $data .= (string) $key . (string) $value;\n66|        }\n67|\n68|        $authToken = (string) Config::get('TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN', '');\n69|        if ($authToken === '') {\n70|            Logger::error('Twilio webhook rejected: auth token not configured');\n71|            http_response_code(401);\n72|            exit;\n73|        }\n74|\n75|        $expected = base64_encode(hash_hmac('sha256', $data, $authToken, true));\n76|        if (!hash_equals($expected, $signature)) {\n77|            Logger::warning('Twilio webhook signature mismatch', [\n78|                'path' => $requestUri,\n79|                'ip'   => $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '',\n80|            ]);\n81|            http_response_code(401);\n82|            exit;\n83|        }\n84|    }\n85|\n86|    /** Shared: respond 200 JSON and stop. */\n87|    private function ok(): void\n88|    {\n89|        http_response_code(200);\n90|        header('Content-Type: application/json');\n91|        echo json_encode(['status' => 'ok']);\n92|        exit;\n93|    }\n94|\n95|    /** POST /webhooks/twilio/sms - inbound SMS. Handles STOP/START keywords. */\n96|    public function sms(): void\n97|    {\n98|        $this->requireValidSignature();\n99|\n100|        $from = trim((string) ($_POST['From'] ?? ''));\n101|        $body = trim((string) ($_POST['Body'] ?? ''));\n102|        $sid  = (string) ($_POST['MessageSid'] ?? '');\n103|\n104|        if ($from === '' || $body === '') {\n105|            Logger::warning('Twilio SMS webhook missing From/Body', ['sid' => $sid]);\n106|            $this->ok();\n107|        }\n108|\n109|        $upper = strtoupper($body);\n110|\n111|        // STOP handling: durable opt-out before anything else. We do NOT send\n112|        // a reply here - Twilio auto-responds at the platform level, and an\n113|        // outbound SMS to an opted-out number would itself violate DNC.\n114|        if (in_array($upper, self::STOP_KEYWORDS, true)) {\n115|            Compliance::recordUnsubscribe(null, $from, 'sms', 'STOP keyword via Twilio webhook', true);\n116|            Logger::info('SMS STOP received', ['from' => $from, 'sid' => $sid]);\n117|            Twilio::logWebhook('sms.incoming', $sid, ['From' => $from, 'Body' => $body, 'MessageSid' => $sid, 'stop' => true]);\n118|            Twilio::processPendingWebhooks();\n119|            $this->ok();\n120|        }\n121|\n122|        // START handling: clear a STOP-derived opt-out so the customer can\n123|        // receive messages again (Twilio platform behavior mirrored locally).\n124|        if (in_array($upper, self::START_KEYWORDS, true)) {\n125|            $this->clearStopOptOut($from);\n126|            Logger::info('SMS START received', ['from' => $from, 'sid' => $sid]);\n127|            Twilio::logWebhook('sms.incoming', $sid, ['From' => $from, 'Body' => $body, 'MessageSid' => $sid, 'start' => true]);\n128|            Twilio::processPendingWebhooks();\n129|            $this->ok();\n130|        }\n131|\n132|        Twilio::logWebhook('sms.incoming', $sid, ['From' => $from, 'Body' => $body, 'MessageSid' => $sid]);\n133|        Twilio::processPendingWebhooks();\n134|        $this->ok();\n135|    }\n136|\n137|    /** POST /webhooks/twilio/status - SMS delivery status updates. */\n138|    public function status(): void\n139|    {\n140|        $this->requireValidSignature();\n141|        Twilio::logWebhook('sms.status', (string) ($_POST['MessageSid'] ?? ''), $_POST);\n142|        Twilio::processPendingWebhooks();\n143|        $this->ok();\n144|    }\n145|\n146|    /** POST /webhooks/twilio/voice - call status updates. */\n147|    public function voice(): void\n148|    {\n149|        $this->requireValidSignature();\n150|        Twilio::logWebhook('voice.status', (string) ($_POST['CallSid'] ?? ''), $_POST);\n151|        Twilio::processPendingWebhooks();\n152|        $this->ok();\n153|    }\n154|\n155|    /** POST /webhooks/twilio/voicemail - voicemail recordings. */\n156|    public function voicemail(): void\n157|    {\n158|        $this->requireValidSignature();\n159|        Twilio::logWebhook('voicemail', (string) ($_POST['CallSid'] ?? ''), $_POST);\n160|        Twilio::processPendingWebhooks();\n161|        $this->ok();\n162|    }\n163|\n164|    /** GET /unsubscribe?token=... - one-click opt-out, HMAC-signed. */\n165|    public function unsubscribe(): void\n166|    {\n167|        $token   = [redacted])\n168|        $payload = Compliance::verifyToken($token);\n169|\n170|        if ($payload === null) {\n171|            http_response_code(400);\n172|            header('Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8');\n173|            echo $this->page('Unsubscribe link invalid',\n174|                '<p>This unsubscribe link is invalid or has expired.</p>'\n175|                . '<p>If you keep getting messages, reply STOP to any text or email '\n176|                . '<a href=\"mailto:no-reply@patriotpest.pro\">no-reply@patriotpest.pro</a>.</p>');\n177|            exit;\n178|        }\n179|\n180|        $email   = isset($payload['e']) && $payload['e'] !== '' ? (string) $payload['e'] : null;\n181|        $phone   = isset($payload['p']) && $payload['p'] !== '' ? (string) $payload['p'] : null;\n182|        $channel = in_array($payload['c'] ?? '', ['email', 'sms', 'all'], true) ? (string) $payload['c'] : 'all';\n183|\n184|        Compliance::recordUnsubscribe($email, $phone, $channel, 'unsubscribed via signed link', true);\n185|        Logger::info('Unsubscribe confirmed', ['email' => $email, 'phone' => $phone, 'channel' => $channel]);\n186|\n187|        header('Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8');\n188|        echo $this->page('You are unsubscribed',\n189|            '<p>Your opt-out has been recorded. You will not receive further marketing '\n190|            . 'messages on ' . ($channel === 'all' ? 'any channel' : 'this channel') . '.</p>'\n191|            . '<p>It may take a day or two for in-flight campaigns to stop. '\n192|            . 'If you change your mind, text START to opt back in.</p>');\n193|        exit;\n194|    }\n195|\n196|    /** Remove STOP-derived opt-outs for a phone (START keyword re-subscribe). */\n197|    private function clearStopOptOut(string $phone): void\n198|    {\n199|        try {\n200|            $db = \\PPC\\Core\\Database::instance();\n201|            $rows = $db->fetchAll(\n202|                \"SELECT id FROM unsubscribes WHERE phone = ? AND (channel = 'sms' OR channel = 'all') AND reason LIKE '%STOP%'\",\n203|                [$phone]\n204|            );\n205|            foreach ($rows as $row) {\n206|                $db->execute('DELETE FROM unsubscribes WHERE id = ?', [(int) $row['id']]);\n207|            }\n208|            $db->execute(\n209|                \"UPDATE customers SET is_no_call = 0, dnc_reason = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\n210|                 WHERE phone = ? AND dnc_reason LIKE '%STOP%'\",\n211|                [$phone]\n212|            );\n213|            Logger::info('SMS re-subscribe cleared opt-out', ['phone' => $phone]);\n214|        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n215|            Logger::warning('START re-subscribe cleanup failed', ['phone' => $phone, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);\n216|        }\n217|    }\n218|\n219|    /** Minimal branded HTML page for the unsubscribe endpoint. */\n220|    private function page(string $title, string $innerHtml): string\n221|    {\n222|        return '<!doctype html><html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\">'\n223|            . '<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width,initial-scale=1\">'\n224|            . '<title>' . htmlspecialchars($title, ENT_QUOTES) . ' | Patriot Pest Control</title>'\n225|            . a plain-text alt is derived).\n31|     * @return bool True if sent (or logged in dev), false on failure.\n32|     */\n33|    public static function send(string $to, string $subject, string $body): bool\n34|    {\n35|        $from     = Config::get('MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS', 'no-reply@patriotpest.pro');\n36|        $fromName = Config::get('MAIL_FROM_NAME', 'Patriot Pest Control');\n37|        $host     = Config::get('MAIL_HOST', '');\n38|\n39|        // Only log to disk in local/dev — production must never write OTP codes\n40|        // or other sensitive message bodies to storage/logs/mail-*.log.\n41|        if (Config::isLocal()) {\n42|            self::log($to, $subject, $body);\n43|        }\n44|\n45|        // In local dev (or with no SMTP configured) we stop at the log — the\n46|        // code/campaign is readable in storage/logs/mail-*.log.\n47|        if (Config::isLocal() || $host === '') {\n48|            Logger::info('Mail logged (dev mode, not sent)', ['to' => $to, 'subject' => $subject]);\n49|            return true;\n50|        }\n51|\n52|        return self::smtp($host, $to, $from, $fromName, $subject, $body);\n53|    }\n54|\n55|    /** Append the message to today's mail log. */\n56|    private static function log(string $to, string $subject, string $body): void\n57|    {\n58|        $dir = BASE_PATH . '/storage/logs';\n59|        if (!is_dir($dir)) {\n60|            @mkdir($dir, 0775, true);\n61|        }\n62|        $entry = str_repeat('=', 70) . \"\\n\"\n63|            . '[' . date('c') . \"] TO: $to\\nSUBJECT: $subject\\n\"\n64|            . str_repeat('-', 70) . \"\\n$body\\n\\n\";\n65|        @file_put_contents($dir . '/mail-' . date('Y-m-d') . '.log', $entry, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);\n66|    }\n67|\n68|    /**\n69|     * Minimal SMTP send over SSL. Returns true on success.\n70|     */\n71|    private static function smtp(string $host, string $to, string $from, string $fromName, string $subject, string $body): bool\n72|    {\n73|        $port     = Config::int('MAIL_PORT', 465);\n74|        $user     = Config::get('MAIL_USERNAME', '');\n75|        $pass     = Config::get('MAIL_PASSWORD', '');\n76|        $security = Config::get('MAIL_SECURITY', 'ssl');\n77|\n78|        $remote = ($security === 'ssl' ? 'ssl://' : '') . $host . ':' . $port;\n79|        $sock   = @stream_socket_client($remote, $errno, $errstr, 15);\n80|        if (!$sock) {\n81|            Logger::error('SMTP connect failed', ['host' => $host, 'error' => $errstr]);\n82|            return false;\n83|        }\n84|        stream_set_timeout($sock, 15);\n85|\n86|        $read = function () use ($sock): string {\n87|            $data = '';\n88|            while (($line = fgets($sock, 515)) !== false) {\n89|                $data .= $line;\n90|                if (strlen($line) < 4 || $line[3] !== '-') {\n91|                    break;\n92|                }\n93|            }\n94|            return $data;\n95|        };\n96|        $send = function (string $cmd) use ($sock, $read): string {\n97|            fwrite($sock, $cmd . \"\\r\\n\");\n98|            return $read();\n99|        };\n100|\n101|        try {\n102|            $read(); // greeting\n103|            $send('EHLO patriotpest.pro');\n104|            if ($user !== '') {\n105|                $send('AUTH LOGIN');\n106|                $send(base64_encode($user));\n107|                $send(base64_encode($pass));\n108|            }\n109|            $send(\"MAIL FROM:<$from>\");\n110|            $send(\"RCPT TO:<$to>\");\n111|            $send('DATA');\n112|\n113|            // Build headers + body.\n114|            $boundary = 'PPC-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));\n115|            $headers  = \"From: $fromName <$from>\\r\\n\"\n116|                . \"To: <$to>\\r\\n\"\n117|                . \"Subject: $subject\\r\\n\"\n118|                . \"Date: \" . date('r') . \"\\r\\n\"\n119|                . \"MIME-Version: 1.0\\r\\n\"\n120|                . \"Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8\\r\\n\"\n121|                . \"Message-ID: <\" . bin2hex(random_bytes(12)) . \"@patriotpest.pro>\\r\\n\";\n122|\n123|            fwrite($sock, $headers . \"\\r\\n\" . $body . \"\\r\\n.\\r\\n\");\n124|            $resp = $read();\n125|            $send('QUIT');\n126|            fclose($sock);\n127|\n128|            $ok = str_starts_with(trim($resp), '250');\n129|            if (!$ok) {\n130|                Logger::error('SMTP DATA rejected', ['to' => $to, 'response' => trim($resp)]);\n131|            }\n132|            return $ok;\n133|        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n134|            Logger::error('SMTP send failed', ['to' => $to, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);\n135|            @fclose($sock);\n136|            return false;\n137|        }\n138|    }\n139|\n140|    /**\n141|     * Wrap a message body in the branded email template (used for OTP + campaigns).\n142|     */\n143|    public static function template(string $heading, string $innerHtml, ?string $unsubscribeUrl = null): string\n144|    {\n145|        $unsub = $unsubscribeUrl\n146|            ? '<p style=\"font-size:12px;color:#8a8f7a;margin-top:28px\">Veteran-owned · WA / ID / OR / AZ · (509) 471-5767</p>'\n155|            . '</div></div>';\n156|    }\n157|}",

                "text": "Read text file `app/Auth/OtpAuth.php`.\n1|<?php\n2|/**\n3| * OtpAuth - passwordless one-time-code authentication.\n4| *\n5| * This is the heart of the login system (no passwords anywhere):\n6| *   1. issue()  - generate a 6-digit code, store a HASH of it (never plaintext),\n7| *                 with expiry + single-use flag, and return the plaintext code\n8| *                 so the caller can email/text it.\n9| *   2. verify() - constant-time compare against the stored hash, enforcing:\n10| *                 expiry, single-use, and a brute-force attempt cap (via\n11| *                 RateLimiter). On success the code is consumed.\n12| *\n13| * Security properties (vs. the old implementation):\n14| *   - codes are hashed with password_hash() at rest,\n15| *   - attempts are counted and lock out after OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS,\n16| *   - codes expire after OTP_TTL seconds,\n17| *   - verification uses hash_equals() (timing-safe),\n18| *   - each code is single-use (used_at set on success).\n19| */\n20|\n21|declare(strict_types=1);\n22|\n23|namespace PPC\\Auth;\n24|\n25|use PPC\\Core\\Config;\n26|use PPC\\Core\\Database;\n27|use PPC\\Core\\Logger;\n28|use PPC\\Core\\RateLimiter;\n29|\n30|final class OtpAuth\n31|{\n32|    /**\n33|     * Issue a new code for $identity. Invalidates any prior unused codes for\n34|     * the same identity+purpose (so only the latest works).\n35|     *\n36|     * @param string $identity Email or phone the code is bound to.\n37|     * @param string $purpose  e.g. 'staff_login', 'customer_login', 'sms_verify'.\n38|     * @return string The plaintext 6-digit code (hand this to the Mailer/SMS).\n39|     */\n40|    public static function issue(string $identity, string $purpose, int $length = 6): string\n41|    {\n42|        $db  = Database::instance();\n43|        $ttl = self::ttlFor($purpose);\n44|\n45|        // Invalidate older unused codes for this identity+purpose.\n46|        $db->execute(\n47|            \"UPDATE otp_codes SET used_at = datetime('now')\n48|             WHERE identity = ? AND purpose = ? AND used_at IS NULL\",\n49|            [$identity, $purpose]\n50|        );\n51|\n52|        // Cryptographically random N-digit code ($length defaults to 6 for backward compat).\n53|        $min = 10 ** ($length - 1);\n54|        $max = (10 ** $length) - 1;\n55|        $code = (string) random_int($min, $max);\n56|\n57|        $db->insert('otp_codes', [\n58|            'identity'   => $identity,\n59|            'purpose'    => $purpose,\n60|            'code_hash'  => password_hash($code, PASSWORD_DEFAULT),\n61|            'attempts'   => 0,\n62|            'expires_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + $ttl),\n63|            'ip'         => RateLimiter::clientIp(),\n64|            'created_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),\n65|        ]);\n66|\n67|        Logger::info('OTP issued', ['identity' => $identity, 'purpose' => $purpose, 'ttl' => $ttl]);\n68|        return $code;\n69|    }\n70|\n71|    /**\n72|     * Verify a submitted code. Returns true only if it matches an unexpired,\n73|     * unused code AND the identity isn't rate-limited. Consumes the code on\n74|     * success and clears the rate-limit counter.\n75|     *\n76|     * @param string $identity Email/phone the code was issued to.\n77|     * @param string $purpose  Must match the purpose it was issued for.\n78|     * @param string $code     The user-submitted code.\n79|     */\n80|    public static function verify(string $identity, string $purpose, string $code): bool\n81|    {\n82|        $db          = Database::instance();\n83|        $maxAttempts = self::maxAttemptsFor($purpose);\n84|        $window      = self::ttlFor($purpose);\n85|        $limitKey    = \"otp:$purpose:$identity\";\n86|\n87|        // Brute-force guard: too many recent failures → reject outright.\n88|        if (RateLimiter::tooMany($limitKey, $maxAttempts, $window)) {\n89|            Logger::warning('OTP verify blocked by rate limit', ['identity' => $identity, 'purpose' => $purpose]);\n90|            return false;\n91|        }\n92|\n93|        // Find the latest unused, unexpired code for this identity+purpose.\n94|        $row = $db->fetch(\n95|            \"SELECT id, code_hash, attempts FROM otp_codes\n96|             WHERE identity = ? AND purpose = ? AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > datetime('now')\n97|             ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1\",\n98|            [$identity, $purpose]\n99|        );\n100|\n101|        if ($row === null) {\n102|            RateLimiter::hit($limitKey, false);\n103|            return false;\n104|        }\n105|\n106|        // Timing-safe comparison against the stored hash.\n107|        $ok = password_verify($code, $row['code_hash']);\n108|\n109|        if (!$ok) {\n110|            // Count the miss (both on the row and the rate limiter).\n111|            $db->execute('UPDATE otp_codes SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = ?', [$row['id']]);\n112|            RateLimiter::hit($limitKey, false);\n113|            Logger::warning('OTP verify failed', ['identity' => $identity, 'purpose' => $purpose]);\n114|            return false;\n115|        }\n116|\n117|        // Success: consume the code (single-use) and clear the limiter.\n118|        $db->execute(\"UPDATE otp_codes SET used_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?\", [$row['id']]);\n119|        RateLimiter::clear($limitKey);\n120|        RateLimiter::hit($limitKey, true); // record the success for audit\n121|        Logger::info('OTP verified', ['identity' => $identity, 'purpose' => $purpose]);\n122|        return true;\n123|    }\n124|\n125|    /**\n126|     * Seconds remaining before a locked-out identity can retry (0 = not locked).\n127|     */\n128|    public static function retryAfter(string $identity, string $purpose): int\n129|    {\n130|        $maxAttempts = self::maxAttemptsFor($purpose);\n131|        $window      = self::ttlFor($purpose);\n132|        return RateLimiter::retryAfter(\"otp:$purpose:$identity\", $maxAttempts, $window);\n133|    }\n134|\n135|    /**\n136|     * TTL (seconds) for a given purpose.\n137|     * 'super-login' -> SU_OTP_TTL (default 300); everything else -> OTP_TTL (default 600).\n138|     */\n139|    public static function ttlFor(string $purpose): int\n140|    {\n141|        if ($purpose === 'super-login') {\n142|            return Config::int('SU_OTP_TTL', 300);\n143|        }\n144|        return Config::int('OTP_TTL', 600);\n145|    }\n146|\n147|    /**\n148|     * Max verify attempts for a given purpose.\n149|     * 'super-login' -> SU_OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3); everything else -> OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 5).\n150|     */\n151|    public static function maxAttemptsFor(string $purpose): int\n152|    {\n153|        if ($purpose === 'super-login') {\n154|            return Config::int('SU_OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS', 3);\n155|        }\n156|        return Config::int('OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS', 5);\n157|    }\n158|}",

'\" value=\"' . htmlspecialchars(self::token(), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '\">';\n46|    }\n47|\n48|    /**\n49|     * Validate a supplied token against the session token (constant-time).\n50|     */\n51|    public static function check(?string $token): [redacted]\n52|    {\n53|        if (!is_string($token) || $token =[redacted]\n54|            return false;\n55|        }\n56|        $expected = Session::get('_csrf_token');\n57|        if (!is_string($expected)) {\n58|            return false;\n59|        }\n60|        return hash_equals($expected, $token);\n61|    }\n62|\n63|    /**\n64|     * Pull the token from the request (POST body first, then header for AJAX).\n65|     */\n66|    public static function fromRequest(): ?string\n67|    {\n68|        if (!empty($_POST[self::FIELD])) {\n69|            return (string) $_POST[self::FIELD];\n70|        }\n71|        // AJAX: check the header (HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN).\n72|        $hdr = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? null;\n73|        return $hdr ? (string) $hdr : null;\n74|    }\n75|\n76|    /**\n77|     * Verify the current request's token; abort with 419 if invalid.\n78|     * Call at the top of every state-changing handler (POST/PUT/DELETE).\n79|     */\n80|    public static function verifyOrDie(): void\n81|    {\n82|        if (!self::check(self::fromRequest())) {\n83|            Logger::warning('CSRF check failed', [\n84|                'path' => $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '?access_token=[redacted] . urlencode($accessToken);\n268|\n269|        $ch = curl_init($url);\n270|        curl_setopt_array($ch, [\n271|            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,\n272|            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT        => 15,\n273|            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER     => ['Accept: application/json'],\n274|        ]);\n275|\n276|        $resp = curl_exec($ch);\n277|        $code = (int) curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);\n278|        $err  = curl_error($ch);\n279|        curl_close($ch);\n280|\n281|        if ($resp === false) {\n282|            Logger::error('Facebook Graph API: cURL error', ['leadgen_id' => $leadgenId, 'error' => $err]);\n283|            return null;\n284|        }\n285|\n286|        if ($code < 200 || $code >= 300) {\n287|            Logger::error('Facebook Graph API: HTTP error', [\n288|                'leadgen_id' => $leadgenId,\n289|                'http_code'  => $code,\n290|                'response'   => substr($resp, 0, 500),\n291|            ]);\n292|            return null;\n293|        }\n294|\n295|        $data = json_decode($resp, true);\n296|        if (!is_array($data)) {\n297|            Logger::error('Facebook Graph API: bad JSON', ['leadgen_id' => $leadgenId]);\n298|            return null;\n299|        }\n300|\n301|        // Graph API returns { field_data: [{ name: \"...\", values: [\"...\"] }, ...] }\n302|        return $data['field_data'] ?? $data;\n303|    }\n304|\n305|    /**\n306|     * Extract a named field from Facebook's field_data array.\n307|     *\n308|     * field_data looks like:\n309|     *   [{\"name\": \"full_name\", \"values\": [\"Jane Doe\"]}, ...]\n310|     */\n311|    private function extractField(array $fieldData, string $name): string\n312|    {\n313|        foreach ($fieldData as $field) {\n314|            if (!is_array($field)) {\n315|                continue;\n316|            }\n317|            if (($field['name'] ?? '') === $name) {\n318|                $values = $field['values'] ?? [];\n319|                return is_array($values) && isset($values[0]) ? (string) $values[0] : '';\n320|            }\n321|        }\n322|        return '';\n323|    }\n324|\n325|    /** Respond 200 OK. Facebook requires a timely 200 to avoid retries. */\n326|    private function ok(): void\n327|    {\n328|        http_response_code(200);\n329|        header('Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8');\n330|        echo 'ok';\n331|        exit;\n332|    }\n333|}",

Two paths max. No escalation tree.\n17| */\n18|\n19|declare(strict_types=1);\n20|\n21|namespace PPC\\Services\\Sms;\n22|\n23|use PPC\\Core\\Config;\n24|use PPC\\Core\\Logger;\n25|\n26|final class SmsService\n27|{\n28|    /**\n29|     * Send a lead notification via email-to-SMS carrier gateway.\n30|     *\n31|     * @param string $leadName  Lead's full name (used in subject line).\n32|     * @param array  $leadData  Associative array with lead fields.\n33|     * @return array{success:bool, method:string, error?:string}\n34|     */\n35|    public static function sendLeadNotification(string $leadName, array $leadData): array\n36|    {\n37|        // Gate: SMS_ENABLED\n38|        if (!Config::bool('LEAD_SMS_ENABLED', false)) {\n39|            Logger::info('Lead SMS skipped: LEAD_SMS_ENABLED=false', ['lead' => $leadName]);\n40|            return self::sendEmailFallback($leadName, $leadData);\n41|        }\n42|\n43|        // Primary: email-to-SMS via carrier gateway\n44|        $gateway = Config::get('LEAD_SMS_TO', '5096664121@vtext.com');\n45|        $subject = 'New Lead: ' . $leadName;\n46|        $body    = self::buildSmsBody($leadData);\n47|\n48|        Logger::info('Lead SMS dispatching', ['gateway' => $gateway, 'lead' => $leadName]);\n49|\n50|        $result = self::smtpSend($gateway, $subject, $body);\n51|\n52|        if ($result['success']) {\n53|            return ['success' => true, 'method' => 'sms'];\n54|        }\n55|\n56|        // Fallback: email\n57|        Logger::warning('Lead SMS failed, falling back to email', [\n58|            'lead'  => $leadName,\n59|            'error' => $result['error'] ?? 'unknown',\n60|        ]);\n61|\n62|        return self::sendEmailFallback($leadName, $leadData);\n63|    }\n64|\n65|    /**\n66|     * Email fallback: sends the lead to LEAD_EMAIL_TO via Titan SMTP.\n67|     */\n68|    private static function sendEmailFallback(string $leadName, array $leadData): array\n69|    {\n70|        $to      = Config::get('LEAD_EMAIL_TO', 'PPC_Info@patriotpest.pro');\n71|        $subject = 'Lead Fallback: ' . $leadName;\n72|        $body    = self::buildEmailBody($leadData);\n73|\n74|        Logger::info('Lead email fallback dispatching', ['to' => $to, 'lead' => $leadName]);\n75|\n76|        $result = self::smtpSend($to, $subject, $body);\n77|\n78|        if ($result['success']) {\n79|            return ['success' => true, 'method' => 'email_fallback'];\n80|        }\n81|\n82|        Logger::error('Lead email fallback also failed', [\n83|            'lead'  => $leadName,\n84|            'error' => $result['error'] ?? '',\n123|            'Email'    => $lead['email'] ?? '',\n124|            'Phone'    => $lead['phone'] ?? '',\n125|            'City'     => $lead['city'] ?? '',\n126|            'State'    => $lead['state'] ?? '',\n127|            'ZIP'      => $lead['zip'] ?? '',\n128|            'Ad ID'    => $lead['ad_id'] ?? ':' . $port;\n166|        $sock   = @stream_socket_client('tcp://' . $remote, $errno, $errstr, 15);\n167|        if (!$sock) {\n168|            Logger::error('Lead SMTP connect failed', ['host' => $host, 'port' => $port, 'error' => $errstr]);\n169|            return ['success' => false, 'error' => \"SMTP connect failed: $errstr\"];\n170|        }\n171|        stream_set_timeout($sock, 15);\n172|\n173|        $read = function () use ($sock): string {\n174|            $data = '';\n175|            while (($line = fgets($sock, 515)) !== false) {\n176|                $data .= $line;\n177|                if (strlen($line) < 4 || $line[3] !== '-') {\n178|                    break;\n179|                }\n180|            }\n181|            return $data;\n182|        };\n183|        $send = function (string $cmd) use ($sock, $read): string {\n184|            fwrite($sock, $cmd . \"\\r\\n\");\n185|            return $read();\n186|        };\n187|\n188|        try {\n189|            $read(); charset=UTF-8\\r\\n\"\n218|                . \"Message-ID: <\" . bin2hex(random_bytes(12)) . \"@patriotpest.pro>\\r\\n\";\n219|\n220|            fwrite($sock, $headers . \"\\r\\n\" . $body . \"\\r\\n.\\r\\n\");\n221|            $resp = $read();\n222|            $send('QUIT');\n223|            fclose($sock);\n224|\n225|            $ok = str_starts_with(trim($resp), '250');\n226|            if (!$ok) {\n227|                Logger::error('Lead SMTP DATA rejected', ['to' => $to, 'response' => trim($resp)]);\n228|                return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'SMTP DATA rejected: ' . trim($resp)];\n229|            }\n230|\n231|            Logger::info('Lead SMTP sent', ['to' => $to, 'subject' => $subject]);\n232|            return ['success' => true];\n233|        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n234|            Logger::error('Lead SMTP send failed', ['to' => $to, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);\n235|            @fclose($sock);\n236|            return ['success' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage()];\n237|        }\n238|    }\n239|}",

                "text": "Read text file `app/Integrations/FieldRoutes.php`.\n1|<?php\n2|/**\n3| * FieldRoutes - read/write client for the FieldRoutes CRM API.\n4| *\n5| * FieldRoutes is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for customers; this app keeps a local\n6| * cache (the `customers` table) plus local-only flags (is_no_call / dnc_reason)\n7| * so reactivation respects opt-outs even offline.         "payload": {

        "payload": {
          "event": {
            "chunk": "Read text file `.env.example`.\n1|# ============================================================\n2|# Patriot Pest Control - Environment Configuration (TEMPLATE)\n3|# ------------------------------------------------------------\n4|# Copy this file to `.env` and fill in REAL values.\n5|#   Windows:  copy .env.example .env\n6|# The `.env` file is git-ignored and must NEVER be committed.\n7|# All keys are read by app/Core/Config.php via a safe parser.\n8|# ============================================================\n9|\n10|# --- Application ---\n11|# APP_ENV: \"local\" | \"staging\" | \"production\"\n12|# APP_DEBUG: \"true\" shows detailed errors (local only). MUST be \"false\" in production.\n13|# APP_URL: canonical site URL (no trailing slash). Used for canonical tags + links.\n14|# APP_KEY: [redacted]\n15|#          php -r \"echo bin2hex(random_bytes(32));\"\n16|APP_ENV=local\n17|APP_DEBUG=true\n18|APP_URL=https://patriotpest.pro\n19|APP_KEY=[redacted]\n20|\n21|# --- Database (SQLite) ---\n22|# DB_PATH is relative to the project root. The file is auto-created + migrated.\n23|DB_DRIVER=sqlite\n24|DB_PATH=database/patriot.db\n25|\n26|# --- Mail (used to send login OTP codes + reactivation campaigns) ---\n27|# Patriot uses Titan email (smtp.titan.email) in production.\n28|MAIL_HOST=smtp.titan.email\n29|MAIL_PORT=465\n30|MAIL_SECURITY=ssl\n31|MAIL_USERNAME=your-sender@patriotpest.pro\n32|MAIL_PASSWORD=[redacted]\n33|MAIL_FROM_NAME=Patriot Pest Control\n34|MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS=david@itak.live\n35|\n36|# --- Twilio (phone intelligence + verified SMS for reactivation) ---\n37|# Lookup v2 uses Account SID + Auth Token (HTTP basic).\n38|TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=ACxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx\n39|TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=[redacted]\n40|[redacted]\n41|TWILIO_SMS_ENABLED=true\n42|# Optional: API key/secret (preferred over auth token for new integrations)\n43|TWILIO_API_KEY=\n[redacted]\n45|\n46|# --- FieldRoutes (source of truth for customers; multi-district) ---\n47|# Live per-district keys/tokens are stored encrypted in the DB (districts table),\n48|# NOT here. These are only fallbacks / connection defaults.\n49|FIELDROUTES_BASE_URL=https://patriotpestc.fieldroutes.com\n50|FIELDROUTES_WA_KEY=\n[redacted]\n52|FIELDROUTES_AZ_KEY=\n[redacted]\n54|\n55|# --- Supabase (blog comments only - optional) ---\n56|SUPABASE_URL=\n57|SUPABASE_KEY=\n[redacted]\n59|# --- AI content generation (blog drafting via n8n / direct API) ---\n60|# Used by the admin CMS \"generate with AI\" feature.\n61|AI_PROVIDER=openai\n62|AI_API_KEY=\n[redacted]\n64|# Optional n8n webhook that triggers automated blog generation:\n65|N8N_WEBHOOK_URL=\n66|\n67|# --- Session / security tuning ---\n68|# Idle timeouts in seconds (overridable from the admin dashboard).\n69|SESSION_LIFETIME_CUSTOMER=900\n70|SESSION_LIFETIME_STAFF=7200\n71|# --- Superuser login (dedicated elevated surface, separate from /login) ---\n72|# Toggleable: when false, /su and /su/verify return 404 (default).\n73|SUPERUSER_ENABLED=false\n74|# OTP validity for superuser codes (seconds, shorter than staff default).\n75|SU_OTP_TTL=300\n76|# Seed email — the account promoted to superuser on first migration.\n77|SU_SEED_EMAIL=david@itak.live\n78|\n79|# OTP validity (seconds) + max attempts before lockout.\n80|OTP_TTL=600\n81|OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5\n82|# Superuser OTP: shorter window, tighter attempt cap (purpose-aware, see OtpAuth::maxAttemptsFor).\n83|SU_OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3\n84|\n85|# --- Analytics (Google Analytics 4 + Google Ads via gtag.js) ---\n86|# GTAG_ID: your GA4 measurement id (G-…). Leave blank if you only run Ads.\n87|# GADS_ID: your Google Ads conversion id (AW-…).\n88|# FB_PIXEL_ID: Meta/Facebook Pixel id (13-16 digits).\n89|# MS_CLARITY_ID: Microsoft Clarity project id (8-12 chars).\n90|# Emitted only when an id is set AND not in local dev (or ANALYTICS_ENABLED=true).\n91|GTAG_ID=\n92|[redacted]\n93|FB_PIXEL_ID=\n94|MS_CLARITY_ID=\n95|ANALYTICS_ENABLED=false\n96|\n97|# --- Geo phone localization ---\n98|# Visitors from Arizona see the AZ line; everyone else sees the main WA line.\n99|# Set GEO_FORCE_REGION to \"wa\" or \"az\" to preview a region locally (blank=auto).\n100|GEO_FORCE_REGION=\n101|API_ENABLED=false\n102|\n103|# --- Facebook Lead Ads webhook ---\n104|# Facebook app secret used to validate X-Hub-Signature-256 on incoming webhooks.\n105|FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET=\n[redacted]\n107|FACEBOOK_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN=\n[redacted]\n109|FACEBOOK_HUB_VERIFY_TOKEN=\n[redacted]\n111|# --- Lead SMS notification (email-to-SMS carrier gateway) ---\n112|# Target: Verizon gateway for 509-666-4121 (Skyler's cell).\n113|# Set LEAD_SMS_ENABLED=true once A2P 10DLC registration is complete.\n114|LEAD_SMS_ENABLED=false\n115|[redacted]@vtext.com\n116|LEAD_SMS_FROM=PPC_Info@patriotpest.pro\n117|LEAD_SMS_BYPASS_DNC=true\n118|LEAD_EMAIL_TO=PPC_Info@patriotpest.pro\n119|# Titan SMTP credentials for email-to-SMS dispatch (port 587, STARTTLS).\n120|LEAD_SMTP_HOST=smtp.titan.email\n121|LEAD_SMTP_PORT=587\n122|LEAD_SMTP_SECURITY=tls\n123|LEAD_SMTP_USERNAME=PPC_Info@patriotpest.pro\n124|LEAD_SMTP_PASSWORD=",

            "chunk": "Read text file `Dockerfile`.\n1|# ============================================================\n2|# Patriot Pest Control - Production Dockerfile\n3|# nginx + php-fpm in one container, non-root where possible\n4|# ============================================================\n5|FROM php:8.3-fpm-alpine\n6|\n7|# Build deps for extensions + runtime packages\n8|RUN apk add --no-cache sqlite-dev nginx supervisor \\\n9|    && docker-php-ext-install pdo pdo_sqlite opcache \\\n10|    && rm -rf /var/cache/apk/*\n11|\n12|# Non-root app user\n13|RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S ppc && adduser -u 1001 -S ppc -G ppc\n14|\n15|WORKDIR /app\n16|\n17|# Copy application\n18|COPY --chown=ppc:ppc . .\n19|\n20|# Writable dirs (777 so php-fpm www-data can create the SQLite db)\n21|RUN mkdir -p storage/logs storage/database /run/nginx \\\n22|    && chown -R ppc:ppc storage database \\\n23|    && chmod -R 777 storage database\n24|\n25|# PHP production config + opcache\n26|RUN mv \"$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini-production\" \"$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini\"\n27|COPY deploy/php-opcache.ini \"$PHP_INI_DIR/conf.d/opcache.ini\"\n28|\n29|# nginx config\n30|COPY deploy/nginx/default.conf /etc/nginx/http.d/default.conf\n31|\n32|# Supervisord config\n33|COPY deploy/supervisord.conf /etc/supervisord.conf\n34|COPY deploy/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh\n35|RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh\n36|\n37|# Health check\n38|HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \\\n39|    CMD wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1/health || exit 1\n40|\n41|ENTRYPOINT [\"/usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh\"]\n42|\n43|EXPOSE 80\n44|",
