            "chunk": "Read text file `database/schema.sql`.\n1|-- ============================================================\n2|-- Patriot Pest Control - SQLite schema (idempotent)\n3|-- Applied automatically by app/Core/Database.php on first run.\n4|-- Every table uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS so re-running is safe.\n5|-- Conventions: snake_case, INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT, UTC timestamps (TEXT ISO-8601).\n6|-- ============================================================\n7|\n8|-- ---------- Meta (schema versioning) ----------\n9|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (\n10|    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n11|    value TEXT\n12|);\n13|\n14|-- ---------- Roles & staff (RBAC) ----------\n15|-- permissions is a JSON array, e.g. [\"all\"] or [\"view_customers\",\"send_messages\"].\n16|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roles (\n17|    role        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n18|    label       TEXT NOT NULL,\n19|    permissions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'\n20|);\n21|\n22|-- Staff have NO password column by design: login is passwordless email-OTP.\n23|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS staff (\n24|    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n25|    email      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n26|    name       TEXT NOT NULL,\n27|    role       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'staff' REFERENCES roles(role),\n28|    active     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n29|    last_login TEXT,\n30|    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n31|);\n32|\n33|-- ---------- Passwordless OTP auth ----------\n34|-- One row per issued code. The code itself is stored HASHED (never plaintext).\n35|-- purpose: 'staff_login' | 'customer_login' | 'sms_verify' | 'unsubscribe_confirm'\n36|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS otp_codes (\n37|    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n38|    identity   TEXT NOT NULL,              -- email or phone the code was sent to\n39|    purpose    TEXT NOT NULL,\n40|    code_hash  TEXT NOT NULL,              -- password_hash() of the 6-digit code\n41|    attempts   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- brute-force counter\n42|    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,              -- now + OTP_TTL\n43|    used_at    TEXT,                       -- set once consumed (single-use)\n44|    ip         TEXT,\n45|    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n46|);\n47|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_otp_identity ON otp_codes(identity, purpose);\n48|\n49|-- Login attempt log → rate limiting + security audit trail.\n50|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS login_attempts (\n51|    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n52|    identity   TEXT NOT NULL,\n53|    ip         TEXT,\n54|    user_agent TEXT,\n55|    success    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n56|    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n57|);\n58|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_login_identity ON login_attempts(identity, created_at);\n59|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_login_ip ON login_attempts(ip, analytics sessions table never collides with\n6|-- the app auth sessions table in database/patriot.db.\n7|--   - visitor_id  : anonymous uuid persisted in localStorage (cross-session)\n8|--   - session_id  : uuid per visit, held in sessionStorage (per-tab)\n9|--   - click_path  : derived VIEW over page_views, never duplicated to disk\n10|--   - timestamps  : ISO-8601 UTC text, always with Z, ============================================================================\n13|\n14|PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;\n15|PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\n16|\n17|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n18|-- VISITORS // one row per anonymous browser identity\n19|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n20|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS visitors (\n21|    visitor_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,               -- uuid from localStorage\n22|    first_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- ISO-8601 UTC\n23|    last_seen_at  TEXT NOT NULL,\n24|    user_agent    TEXT,\n25|    referrer      TEXT,                           -- first referrer for visitor\n26|    device_class  TEXT                            -- desktop | mobile | tablet\n27|);\n28|\n29|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n30|-- SESSIONS // one row per visit\n31|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n32|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n33|    session_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,               -- uuid from sessionStorage\n34|    visitor_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visitors(visitor_id),\n35|    started_at    TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- ISO-8601 UTC\n36|    ended_at      TEXT,                           -- set at unload / timeout\n37|    duration_sec  INTEGER,                        -- ended_at - started_at\n38|    entry_page    TEXT,                           -- first page_path\n39|    exit_page     TEXT,                           -- last page_path\n40|    referrer      TEXT,\n41|    user_agent    TEXT,\n42|    device_class  TEXT,\n43|    is_bounce     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0      -- 1 = 1 page AND <10s\n44|);\n45|\n46|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_visitor   ON sessions(visitor_id);\n47|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_started   ON sessions(started_at);\n48|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_referrer  ON sessions(referrer);\n49|\n50|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n51|-- PAGE_VIEWS // every page load, ordered per session\n52|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n53|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_views (\n54|    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n55|    session_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(session_id),\n56|    visitor_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visitors(visitor_id),\n57|    page_path     TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- e.g. /prices\n58|    page_title    TEXT,\n59|    referrer      TEXT,                           -- per-view referrer\n60|    viewed_at     TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- ISO-8601 UTC\n61|    view_order    INTEGER NOT NULL                -- 1,2,3... within session\n62|);\n63|\n64|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pv_session_order ON page_views(session_id, view_order);\n65|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pv_page         ON page_views(page_path);\n66|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pv_viewed_at    ON page_views(viewed_at);\n67|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pv_visitor      ON page_views(visitor_id);\n68|\n69|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n70|-- EVENTS // custom interaction events (link clicks, easter egg, etc.)\n71|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n72|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (\n73|    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n74|    session_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(session_id),\n75|    visitor_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visitors(visitor_id),\n76|    event_name    TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- link_click | easter_egg_reveal | ...\n77|    page_path     TEXT,\n78|    payload       TEXT,                           -- JSON: {target, label, value}\n79|    occurred_at   TEXT NOT NULL\n80|);\n81|\n82|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_name  ON events(event_name, occurred_at);\n83|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_sess  ON events(session_id);\n84|\n85|--      row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY view_order) AS rn\n100|    FROM page_views\n101|)\n102|GROUP BY session_id, visitor_id;",

              {
                "text": "Read text file `database/schema.sql`.\n1|-- ============================================================\n2|-- Patriot Pest Control - SQLite schema (idempotent)\n3|-- Applied automatically by app/Core/Database.php on first run.\n4|-- Every table uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS so re-running is safe.\n5|-- Conventions: snake_case, INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT, UTC timestamps (TEXT ISO-8601).\n6|-- ============================================================\n7|\n8|-- ---------- Meta (schema versioning) ----------\n9|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (\n10|    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n11|    value TEXT\n12|);\n13|\n14|-- ---------- Roles & staff (RBAC) ----------\n15|-- permissions is a JSON array, e.g. [\"all\"] or [\"view_customers\",\"send_messages\"].\n16|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roles (\n17|    role        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n18|    label       TEXT NOT NULL,\n19|    permissions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'\n20|);\n21|\n22|-- Staff have NO password column by design: login is passwordless email-OTP.\n23|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS staff (\n24|    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n25|    email      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n26|    name       TEXT NOT NULL,\n27|    role       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'staff' REFERENCES roles(role),\n28|    active     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n29|    last_login TEXT,\n30|    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n31|);\n32|\n33|-- ---------- Passwordless OTP auth ----------\n34|-- One row per issued code. The code itself is stored HASHED (never plaintext).\n35|-- purpose: 'staff_login' | 'customer_login' | 'sms_verify' | 'unsubscribe_confirm'\n36|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS otp_codes (\n37|    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n38|    identity   TEXT NOT NULL,              -- email or phone the code was sent to\n39|    purpose    TEXT NOT NULL,\n40|    code_hash  TEXT NOT NULL,              -- password_hash() of the 6-digit code\n41|    attempts   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- brute-force counter\n42|    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,              -- now + OTP_TTL\n43|    used_at    TEXT,                       -- set once consumed (single-use)\n44|    ip         TEXT,\n45|    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n46|);\n47|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_otp_identity ON SCHEMA // STORAGE/RETENTION.SQLITE\n3|-- Owner: Nash (data model) / Edison (implementation).\n4|-- Mirrors analytics/retention_tracking/RETENTION_SCHEMA.sql exactly.\n5|-- Separate database file so the analytics sessions table never collides with\n6|-- the app auth sessions table in database/patriot.db.\n7|--   - visitor_id  : anonymous uuid persisted in localStorage (cross-session)\n8|--   - session_id  : uuid per visit, held in sessionStorage (per-tab)\n9|--   - click_path  : derived VIEW over page_views, never duplicated to disk\n10|--   - timestamps  : ISO-8601 UTC text, always with Z, sortable and portable\n11|--   - referrer    : captured per visitor (first), per session, per page view\n12|-- ============================================================================\n13|\n14|PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;\n15|PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\n16|\n17|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n18|-- VISITORS // one row per anonymous browser identity\n19|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n20|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS visitors (\n21|    visitor_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,               -- uuid from localStorage\n22|    first_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- ISO-8601 UTC\n23|    last_seen_at  TEXT NOT NULL,\n24|    user_agent    TEXT,\n25|    referrer      TEXT,                           -- first referrer for visitor\n26|    device_class  TEXT                            -- desktop | mobile | tablet\n27|);\n28|\n29|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n30|-- SESSIONS // one row per visit\n31|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n32|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n33|    session_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,               -- uuid from sessionStorage\n34|    visitor_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visitors(visitor_id),\n35|    started_at    TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- ISO-8601 UTC\n36|    ended_at      TEXT,                           -- set at unload / timeout\n37|    duration_sec  INTEGER,                        -- ended_at - started_at\n38|    entry_page    TEXT,                           -- first page_path\n39|    exit_page     TEXT,                           -- last page_path\n40|    referrer      TEXT,\n41|    user_agent    TEXT,\n42|    device_class  TEXT,\n43|    is_bounce     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0      -- 1 = 1 page AND <10s\n44|);\n45|\n46|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_visitor   ON sessions(visitor_id);\n47|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_started   ON sessions(started_at);\n48|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_referrer  ON sessions(referrer);\n49|\n50|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n51|-- PAGE_VIEWS // every page load, ordered per session\n52|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n53|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_views (\n54|    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n55|    session_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(session_id),\n56|    visitor_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visitors(visitor_id),\n57|    page_path     TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- e.g. /prices\n58|    page_title    TEXT,\n59|    referrer      TEXT,                           -- per-view referrer\n60|    viewed_at     TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- ISO-8601 UTC\n61|    view_order    INTEGER NOT NULL                -- 1,2,3... within session\n62|);\n63|\n64|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pv_session_order ON page_views(session_id, view_order);\n65|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pv_page         ON page_views(page_path);\n66|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pv_viewed_at    ON page_views(viewed_at);\n67|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pv_visitor      ON page_views(visitor_id);\n68|\n69|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n70|-- EVENTS // custom interaction events (link clicks, easter egg, etc.)\n71|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n72|CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (\n73|    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n74|    session_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(session_id),\n75|    visitor_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visitors(visitor_id),\n76|    event_name    TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- link_click | easter_egg_reveal | ...\n77|    page_path     TEXT,\n78|    payload       TEXT,                           -- JSON: {target, label, value}\n79|    occurred_at   TEXT NOT NULL\n80|);\n81|\n82|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_name  ON events(event_name, occurred_at);\n83|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_sess  ON events(session_id);\n84|\n85|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n86|-- CLICK_PATH // ordered page-visit sequences per session (derived, read-only)\n87|-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n88|CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS click_path AS\n89|SELECT\n90|    session_id,\n91|    visitor_id,\n92|    group_concat(page_path, ' > ') AS path,\n93|    count(*)                        AS pages_visited\n94|FROM (\n95|    SELECT\n96|        session_id,\n97|        visitor_id,\n98|        page_path,\n99|        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY view_order) AS rn\n100|    FROM page_views\n101|)\n102|GROUP BY session_id, visitor_id;",

Leave blank if you only run Ads.\n87|# GADS_ID: your Google Ads conversion id (AW-…).\n88|# FB_PIXEL_ID: Meta/Facebook Pixel id (13-16 digits).\n89|# MS_CLARITY_ID: Microsoft Clarity project id (8-12 chars).\n90|# Emitted only when an id is set AND not in local dev (or ANALYTICS_ENABLED=true).\n91|GTAG_ID=\n92|[redacted]\n93|FB_PIXEL_ID=\n94|MS_CLARITY_ID=\n95|ANALYTICS_ENABLED=false\n96|\n97|# --- Geo phone localization ---\n98|# Visitors from Arizona see the AZ line; everyone else sees the main WA line.\n99|# Set GEO_FORCE_REGION to \"wa\" or \"az\" to preview a region locally (blank=auto).\n100|GEO_FORCE_REGION=\n101|API_ENABLED=false\n102|\n103|# --- Facebook Lead Ads webhook ---\n104|# Facebook app secret used to validate X-Hub-Signature-256 on incoming webhooks.\n105|FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET=\n[redacted]\n107|FACEBOOK_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN=\n[redacted]\n109|FACEBOOK_HUB_VERIFY_TOKEN=\n[redacted]\n111|# --- Lead SMS notification (email-to-SMS carrier gateway) ---\n112|# Target: Verizon gateway for 509-666-4121 (Skyler's cell).\n113|# Set LEAD_SMS_ENABLED=true once A2P 10DLC registration is complete.\n114|LEAD_SMS_ENABLED=false\n115|[redacted]@vtext.com\n116|LEAD_SMS_FROM=PPC_Info@patriotpest.pro\n117|LEAD_SMS_BYPASS_DNC=true\n118|LEAD_EMAIL_TO=PPC_Info@patriotpest.pro\n119|# Titan SMTP credentials for email-to-SMS dispatch (port 587, STARTTLS).\n120|LEAD_SMTP_HOST=smtp.titan.email\n121|LEAD_SMTP_PORT=587\n122|LEAD_SMTP_SECURITY=tls\n123|LEAD_SMTP_USERNAME=PPC_Info@patriotpest.pro\n124|LEAD_SMTP_PASSWORD=",

                "text": "Read text file `Dockerfile`.\n1|# ============================================================\n2|# Patriot Pest Control - Production Dockerfile\n3|# nginx + php-fpm in one container, non-root where possible\n4|# ============================================================\n5|FROM php:8.3-fpm-alpine\n6|\n7|# Build deps for extensions + runtime packages\n8|RUN apk add --no-cache sqlite-dev nginx supervisor \\\n9|    && docker-php-ext-install pdo pdo_sqlite opcache \\\n10|    && rm -rf /var/cache/apk/*\n11|\n12|# Non-root app user\n13|RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S ppc && adduser -u 1001 -S ppc -G ppc\n14|\n15|WORKDIR /app\n16|\n17|# Copy application\n18|COPY --chown=ppc:ppc . .\n19|\n20|# Writable dirs (777 so php-fpm www-data can create the SQLite db)\n21|RUN mkdir -p storage/logs storage/database /run/nginx \\\n22|    && chown -R ppc:ppc storage database \\\n23|    && chmod -R 777 storage database\n24|\n25|# PHP production config + opcache\n26|RUN mv \"$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini-production\" \"$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini\"\n27|COPY deploy/php-opcache.ini \"$PHP_INI_DIR/conf.d/opcache.ini\"\n28|\n29|# nginx config\n30|COPY deploy/nginx/default.conf /etc/nginx/http.d/default.conf\n31|\n32|# Supervisord config\n33|COPY deploy/supervisord.conf /etc/supervisord.conf\n34|COPY deploy/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh\n35|RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh\n36|\n37|# Health check\n38|HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \\\n39|    CMD wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1/health || exit 1\n40|\n41|ENTRYPOINT [\"/usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh\"]\n42|\n43|EXPOSE 80\n44|",

            "chunk": "Read text file `tests/RouteRegistrationTest.php`.\n1|<?php\n2|\n3|declare(strict_types=1);\n4|\n5|use PHPUnit\\Framework\\Attributes\\Test;\n6|use PHPUnit\\Framework\\TestCase;\n7|use PPC\\Core\\Router;\n8|\n9|/**\n10| * Route-registration smoke test.\n11| *\n12| * Catches the defect class that phpunit unit tests and php -l cannot see:\n13| * a route handler referencing a controller class that does not resolve\n14| * (missing use import, renamed class, deleted file) or a method that does\n15| * not exist. Router::invoke() does `new $class()` at dispatch time, so\n16| * these failures only surface on a real HTTP request.\n17| *\n18| * Two real defects of this class shipped in Part E and were only caught at\n19| * dispatch level: public/index.php registered ApiController::class and\n20| * ApiKeyController::class routes without the `use` imports, so every\n21| * /api/v1/* and /admin/api-keys* request fataled \"Class not found\". This\n22| * test makes that class of regression impossible to repeat.\n23| *\n24| * Runs in routes-only mode (PPC_ROUTES_ONLY): public/index.php registers\n25| * every route exactly as a real request would, then stops before dispatch.\n26| * app/bootstrap.php skips global error handlers and the session in this\n27| * mode so the test has no side effects to clean up.\n28| */\n29|final class RouteRegistrationTest extends TestCase\n30|{\n31|    #[Test]\n32|    public function every_route_controller_class_resolves(): void\n33|    {\n34|        // Force the API surface ON so its routes are registered and checked\n35|        // even when the deployment default (API_ENABLED=false) would skip\n36|        // them. Also force APP_ENV=local so the production HTTPS-force\n37|        // redirect in the front controller can never fire and exit.\n38|        $prevApi = getenv('API_ENABLED');\n39|        $prevSu  = getenv('SUPERUSER_ENABLED');\n40|        $prevEnv = getenv('APP_ENV');\n41|        putenv('API_ENABLED=true');\n42|        putenv('SUPERUSER_ENABLED=true');\n43|        putenv('APP_ENV=local');\n44|\n45|        $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] = 'GET';\n46|        $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI']    = '/route-registration-smoke-test';\n47|\n48|        try {\n49|            if (!defined('PPC_ROUTES_ONLY')) {\n50|                define('PPC_ROUTES_ONLY', true);\n51|            }\n52|            require BASE_PATH . '/public/index.php';\n53|\n54|            $routes = Router::routes();\n55|            $this->assertNotEmpty($routes, 'No routes registered - front controller did not load');\n56|\n57|            $handlersChecked = 0;\n58|            foreach ($routes as $route) {\n59|                $handler = $route->handler;\n60|                if (!is_array($handler) || count($handler) !== 2) {\n61|                    continue; // closures are callable by construction\n62|                }\n63|                [$class, $method] = $handler;\n64|                $this->assertTrue(\n65|                    class_exists($class),\n66|                    \"Route handler class {$class} does not resolve (missing use import or file) - dispatch would fatal 'Class not found'\"\n67|                );\n68|                $this->assertTrue(\n69|                    method_exists($class, $method),\n70|                    \"Route handler method {$class}::{$method} does not exist\"\n71|                );\n72|                $instance = new $class();\n73|                $this->assertTrue(\n74|                    is_callable([$instance, $method]),\n75|                    \"Route handler {$class}::{$method} is not callable on a fresh instance\"\n76|                );\n77|                $handlersChecked++;\n78|            }\n79|            $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $handlersChecked, 'No array-style [Class, method] handlers found - nothing to assert');\n80|        } finally {\n81|            // Restore env so later tests in this process see the original state.\n82|            if ($prevApi === false) {\n83|                putenv('API_ENABLED');\n84|            } else {\n85|                putenv('API_ENABLED=' . $prevApi);\n86|            }\n87|            if ($prevSu === false) {\n88|                putenv('SUPERUSER_ENABLED');\n89|            } else {\n90|                putenv('SUPERUSER_ENABLED=' . $prevSu);\n91|            }\n92|            if ($prevEnv === false) {\n93|                putenv('APP_ENV');\n94|            } else {\n95|                putenv('APP_ENV=' . $prevEnv);\n96|            }\n97|        }\n98|    }\n99|}",

                "text": "Read text file `tests/RouteRegistrationTest.php`.\n1|<?php\n2|\n3|declare(strict_types=1);\n4|\n5|use PHPUnit\\Framework\\Attributes\\Test;\n6|use PHPUnit\\Framework\\TestCase;\n7|use PPC\\Core\\Router;\n8|\n9|/**\n10| * Route-registration smoke test.\n11| *\n12| * Catches the defect class that phpunit unit tests and php -l cannot see:\n13| * a route handler referencing a controller class that does not resolve\n14| * (missing use import, renamed class, deleted file) or a method that does\n15| * not exist. Router::invoke() does `new $class()` at dispatch time, so\n16| * these failures only surface on a real HTTP request.\n17| *\n18| * Two real defects of this class shipped in Part E and were only caught at\n19| * dispatch level: public/index.php registered ApiController::class and\n20| * ApiKeyController::class routes without the `use` imports, so every\n21| * /api/v1/* and /admin/api-keys* request fataled \"Class not found\". This\n22| * test makes that class of regression impossible to repeat.\n23| *\n24| * Runs in routes-only mode (PPC_ROUTES_ONLY): public/index.php registers\n25| * every route exactly as a real request would, then stops before dispatch.\n26| * app/bootstrap.php skips global error handlers and the session in this\n27| * mode so the test has no side effects to clean up.\n28| */\n29|final class RouteRegistrationTest extends TestCase\n30|{\n31|    #[Test]\n32|    public function every_route_controller_class_resolves(): void\n33|    {\n34|        // Force the API surface ON so its routes are registered and checked\n35|        // even when the deployment default (API_ENABLED=false) would skip\n36|        // them. Also force APP_ENV=local so the production HTTPS-force\n37|        // redirect in the front controller can never fire and exit.\n38|        $prevApi = getenv('API_ENABLED');\n39|        $prevSu  = getenv('SUPERUSER_ENABLED');\n40|        $prevEnv = getenv('APP_ENV');\n41|        putenv('API_ENABLED=true');\n42|        putenv('SUPERUSER_ENABLED=true');\n43|        putenv('APP_ENV=local');\n44|\n45|        $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] = 'GET';\n46|        $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI']    = '/route-registration-smoke-test';\n47|\n48|        try {\n49|            if (!defined('PPC_ROUTES_ONLY')) {\n50|                define('PPC_ROUTES_ONLY', true);\n51|            }\n52|            require BASE_PATH . '/public/index.php';\n53|\n54|            $routes = Router::routes();\n55|            $this->assertNotEmpty($routes, 'No routes registered - front controller did not load');\n56|\n57|            $handlersChecked = 0;\n58|            foreach ($routes as $route) {\n59|                $handler = $route->handler;\n60|                if (!is_array($handler) || count($handler) !== 2) {\n61|                    continue; // closures are callable by construction\n62|                }\n63|                [$class, $method] = $handler;\n64|                $this->assertTrue(\n65|                    class_exists($class),\n66|                    \"Route handler class {$class} does not resolve (missing use import or file) - dispatch would fatal 'Class not found'\"\n67|                );\n68|                $this->assertTrue(\n69|                    method_exists($class, $method),\n70|                    \"Route handler method {$class}::{$method} does not exist\"\n71|                );\n72|                $instance = new $class();\n73|                $this->assertTrue(\n74|                    is_callable([$instance, $method]),\n75|                    \"Route handler {$class}::{$method} is not callable on a fresh instance\"\n76|                );\n77|                $handlersChecked++;\n78|            }\n79|            $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $handlersChecked, 'No array-style [Class, method] handlers found - nothing to assert');\n80|        } finally {\n81|            // Restore env so later tests in this process see the original state.\n82|            if ($prevApi === false) {\n83|                putenv('API_ENABLED');\n84|            } else {\n85|                putenv('API_ENABLED=' . $prevApi);\n86|            }\n87|            if ($prevSu === false) {\n88|                putenv('SUPERUSER_ENABLED');\n89|            } else {\n90|                putenv('SUPERUSER_ENABLED=' . $prevSu);\n91|            }\n92|            if ($prevEnv === false) {\n93|                putenv('APP_ENV');\n94|            } else {\n95|                putenv('APP_ENV=' . $prevEnv);\n96|            }\n97|        }\n98|    }\n99|}",

        "payload": {
          "event": {
            "chunk": "{\n  \"chunk_id\": \"exec-9-1\",\n  \"command\": \"ls -la /mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/.env 2>&1 | head -5; cat /mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/deploy/entrypoint.sh 2>&1 | head -80; cat /mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/deploy/supervisord.conf 2>&1 | head -60; cat /mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/deploy/nginx/default.conf 2>&1 | head -80\",\n  \"description\": \"Check deployment configs\",\n  \"exit_code\": 0,\n  \"terminal_status\": \"completed\",\n  \"output\": \"-rwxrwxrwx 1 david david 2518 Aug 10 19:53 /mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/.env\\n#!/bin/sh\\r\\n# ============================================================\\r\\n# Patriot Pest Control - container entrypoint\\r\\n# 0. Fix the database volume ownership so the app can write it.\\r\\n#    The Dockerfile chowns /app/database at image build time, but\\r\\n#    a mounted volume overrides that with host ownership on boot.\\r\\n#    php-fpm runs as www-data (uid 82, the base image default), so\\r\\n#    the volume must be world-writable (777) for the app to create\\r\\n#    and write the SQLite file. Re-applied BEFORE seeding (fixes an\\r\\n#    existing volume) and AFTER seeding (the seed runs as root and\\r\\n#    creates the DB file, which must also be writable by www-data).\\r\\n#    Guarded: only as root. Idempotent: safe on every boot. Tolerant:\\r\\n#    a failed fix (read-only mount) still boots so pages keep serving.\\r\\n# 1. Seed the app DB if it is missing or empty (idempotent; the\\r\\n#    seed copy ships zero em dashes per ORDER 2). Runs on every\\r\\n#    boot so the DB self-heals across deploys and volume resets.\\r\\n# 2. Hand off to supervisord (php-fpm + nginx).\\r\\n# ============================================================\\r\\nset -e\\r\\n\\r\\nfix_database_perms() {\\r\\n  chown -R ppc:ppc /app/database 2>/dev/null || true\\r\\n  chmod -R 777 /app/database 2>/dev/null || true\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nif [ \\\"$(id -u)\\\" -eq 0 ]; then\\r\\n  echo \\\"[entrypoint] fixing database volume permissions (root)...\\\"\\r\\n  if fix_database_perms; then\\r\\n    echo \\\"[entrypoint] database volume permissions OK\\\"\\r\\n  else\\r\\n    echo \\\"[entrypoint] volume permission fix failed, continuing (mount may be read-only)\\\"\\r\\n  fi\\r\\nelse\\r\\n  echo \\\"[entrypoint] not root, skipping database volume permission fix\\\"\\r\\nfi\\r\\n\\r\\nif [ -f /app/bin/seed.php ]; then\\r\\n  echo \\\"[entrypoint] seeding database (idempotent)...\\\"\\r\\n  php /app/bin/seed.php || echo \\\"[entrypoint] seed failed, continuing\\\"\\r\\nfi\\r\\n\\r\\nif [ -f /app/bin/import-blog.php ]; then\\r\\n  echo \\\"[entrypoint] importing blog corpus (idempotent)...\\\"\\r\\n  php /app/bin/import-blog.php || echo \\\"[entrypoint] blog import failed, continuing\\\"\\r\\nfi\\r\\n\\r\\n# The seed runs as root and (re)creates the DB file, so re-apply the\\r\\n# permissions after seeding or the php-fpm worker (www-data) cannot\\r\\n# write the file even though the directory is correct.\\r\\nif [ \\\"$(id -u)\\\" -eq 0 ]; then\\r\\n  echo \\\"[entrypoint] re-applying database volume permissions after seed (root)...\\\"\\r\\n  fix_database_perms || echo \\\"[entrypoint] post-seed permission fix failed, continuing\\\"\\r\\nfi\\r\\n\\r\\necho \\\"[entrypoint] starting supervisord\\\"\\r\\nexec /usr/bin/supervisord -c /etc/supervisord.conf\\r\\n[supervisord]\\nnodaemon=true\\nlogfile=/dev/null\\nlogfile_maxbytes=0\\n\\n[program:php-fpm]\\ncommand=php-fpm --nodaemonize\\nautostart=true\\nautorestart=true\\nstdout_logfile=/dev/fd/2\\nstdout_logfile_maxbytes=0\\nstderr_logfile=/dev/fd/2\\nstderr_logfile_maxbytes=0\\n\\n[program:nginx]\\ncommand=nginx -g \\\"daemon off;\\\"\\nautostart=true\\nautorestart=true\\nstdout_logfile=/dev/fd/1\\nstdout_logfile_maxbytes=0\\nstderr_logfile=/dev/fd/2\\nstderr_logfile_maxbytes=0\\nserver {\\r\\n    listen 80;\\r\\n    server_name _;\\r\\n    root /app/public;\\r\\n    index index.php;\\r\\n\\r\\n    # Security headers\\r\\n    add_header X-Frame-Options \\\"SAMEORIGIN\\\" always;\\r\\n    add_header X-Content-Type-Options \\\"nosniff\\\" always;\\r\\n    add_header X-XSS-Protection \\\"1; mode=block\\\" always;\\r\\n    add_header Referrer-Policy \\\"strict-origin-when-cross-origin\\\" always;\\r\\n    add_header Strict-Transport-Security \\\"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains\\\" always;\\r\\n\\r\\n    # Gzip\\r\\n    gzip on;\\r\\n    gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript application/manifest+json text/xml application/xml image/svg+xml;\\r\\n    gzip_min_length 256;\\r\\n\\r\\n    # PWA: service worker must be revalidated (never long-cached) or\\r\\n    # browsers will not pick up updates. The manifest needs the correct\\r\\n    # MIME type or Chrome will not treat it as a web app manifest.\\r\\n    location = /sw.js {\\r\\n        default_type text/javascript;\\r\\n        add_header Cache-Control \\\"no-cache\\\";\\r\\n        add_header X-Content-Type-Options \\\"nosniff\\\" always;\\r\\n        try_files $uri =404;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    location ~* \\\\.(webmanifest)$ {\\r\\n        default_type application/manifest+json;\\r\\n        add_header Cache-Control \\\"no-cache\\\";\\r\\n        add_header X-Content-Type-Options \\\"nosniff\\\" always;\\r\\n        try_files $uri =404;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    # Static assets: long cache\\r\\n    location ~* \\\\.(css|js|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|ico|svg|woff|woff2|ttf|eot)$ {\\r\\n        expires 30d;\\r\\n        add_header Cache-Control \\\"public, immutable\\\";\\r\\n        try_files $uri =404;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    # PHP front controller\\r\\n    location / {\\r\\n        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$query_string;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    location ~ \\\\.php$ {\\r\\n        fastcgi_pass 127.0.0.1:9000;\\r\\n        fastcgi_index index.php;\\r\\n        fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME $document_root$fastcgi_script_name;\\r\\n        include fastcgi_params;\\r\\n        # TLS is terminated by the Dokploy reverse proxy, which forwards\\r\\n        # X-Forwarded-Proto. Map that to PHP's HTTPS flag so the app can\\r\\n        # build correct canonical URLs (webhook signature validation needs\\r\\n        # the https scheme to match Twilio's configured webhook URL).\\r\\n        set $pp_https off;\\r\\n        if ($http_x_forwarded_proto = 'https') { set $pp_https on; }\\r\\n        fastcgi_param HTTPS $pp_https;\\r\\n        fastcgi_read_timeout 60s;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    # Block dotfiles\\r\\n    location ~ /\\\\. {\\r\\n        deny all;\\r\\n        access_log off;\\r\\n        log_not_found off;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    # Block direct access to sensitive dirs\\r\\n    location ~ ^/(app|config|database|storage|templates|bin|vendor)/ {\\r\\n        deny all;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log;\\r\\n    error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\",\n  \"original_output_bytes\": 5674,\n  \"original_output_tokens\": 1419,\n  \"truncated\": false\n}",

              {
                "text": "Read text file `tests/bootstrap.php`.\n1|<?php\n2|declare(strict_types=1);\n3|// Test bootstrap: loads the app without starting a session.\n4|define(\"BASE_PATH\", dirname(__DIR__));\n5|require BASE_PATH . \"/app/Core/Config.php\";\n6|\\PPC\\Core\\Config::load(BASE_PATH . \"/.env\");\n7|spl_autoload_register(function (string $class): void {\n8|    $prefix = \"PPC\\\\\";\n9|    if (!str_starts_with($class, $prefix)) { return; }\n10|    $relative = substr($class, strlen($prefix));\n11|    $file = BASE_PATH . \"/app/\" . str_replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\", $relative) . \".php\";\n12|    if (is_readable($file)) { require $file; }\n13|});\n14|require __DIR__ . \"/../vendor/autoload.php\";",
                "tool_call_id": "call_[redacted]",
                "tool_call_index": 0
              },
              {
                "text": "{\n  \"chunk_id\": \"exec-9-1\",\n  \"command\": \"ls -la /mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/.env 2>&1 | head -5; cat /mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/deploy/entrypoint.sh 2>&1 | head -80; cat /mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/deploy/supervisord.conf 2>&1 | head -60; cat /mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/deploy/nginx/default.conf 2>&1 | head -80\",\n  \"description\": \"Check deployment configs\",\n  \"exit_code\": 0,\n  \"terminal_status\": \"completed\",\n  \"output\": \"-rwxrwxrwx 1 david david 2518 Aug 10 19:53 /mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/.env\\n#!/bin/sh\\r\\n# ============================================================\\r\\n# Patriot Pest Control - container entrypoint\\r\\n# 0. Fix the database volume ownership so the app can write it.\\r\\n#    The Dockerfile chowns /app/database at image build time, but\\r\\n#    a mounted volume overrides that with host ownership on boot.\\r\\n#    php-fpm runs as www-data (uid 82, the base image default), so\\r\\n#    the volume must be world-writable (777) for the app to create\\r\\n#    and write the SQLite file. Re-applied BEFORE seeding (fixes an\\r\\n#    existing volume) and AFTER seeding (the seed runs as root and\\r\\n#    creates the DB file, which must also be writable by www-data).\\r\\n#    Guarded: only as root. Idempotent: safe on every boot. Tolerant:\\r\\n#    a failed fix (read-only mount) still boots so pages keep serving.\\r\\n# 1. Seed the app DB if it is missing or empty (idempotent; the\\r\\n#    seed copy ships zero em dashes per ORDER 2). Runs on every\\r\\n#    boot so the DB self-heals across deploys and volume resets.\\r\\n# 2. Hand off to supervisord (php-fpm + nginx).\\r\\n# ============================================================\\r\\nset -e\\r\\n\\r\\nfix_database_perms() {\\r\\n  chown -R ppc:ppc /app/database 2>/dev/null || true\\r\\n  chmod -R 777 /app/database 2>/dev/null || true\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nif [ \\\"$(id -u)\\\" -eq 0 ]; then\\r\\n  echo \\\"[entrypoint] fixing database volume permissions (root)...\\\"\\r\\n  if fix_database_perms; then\\r\\n    echo \\\"[entrypoint] database volume permissions OK\\\"\\r\\n  else\\r\\n    echo \\\"[entrypoint] volume permission fix failed, continuing (mount may be read-only)\\\"\\r\\n  fi\\r\\nelse\\r\\n  echo \\\"[entrypoint] not root, skipping database volume permission fix\\\"\\r\\nfi\\r\\n\\r\\nif [ -f /app/bin/seed.php ]; then\\r\\n  echo \\\"[entrypoint] seeding database (idempotent)...\\\"\\r\\n  php /app/bin/seed.php || echo \\\"[entrypoint] seed failed, continuing\\\"\\r\\nfi\\r\\n\\r\\nif [ -f /app/bin/import-blog.php ]; then\\r\\n  echo \\\"[entrypoint] importing blog corpus (idempotent)...\\\"\\r\\n  php /app/bin/import-blog.php || echo \\\"[entrypoint] blog import failed, continuing\\\"\\r\\nfi\\r\\n\\r\\n# The seed runs as root and (re)creates the DB file, so re-apply the\\r\\n# permissions after seeding or the php-fpm worker (www-data) cannot\\r\\n# write the file even though the directory is correct.\\r\\nif [ \\\"$(id -u)\\\" -eq 0 ]; then\\r\\n  echo \\\"[entrypoint] re-applying database volume permissions after seed (root)...\\\"\\r\\n  fix_database_perms || echo \\\"[entrypoint] post-seed permission fix failed, continuing\\\"\\r\\nfi\\r\\n\\r\\necho \\\"[entrypoint] starting supervisord\\\"\\r\\nexec /usr/bin/supervisord -c /etc/supervisord.conf\\r\\n[supervisord]\\nnodaemon=true\\nlogfile=/dev/null\\nlogfile_maxbytes=0\\n\\n[program:php-fpm]\\ncommand=php-fpm --nodaemonize\\nautostart=true\\nautorestart=true\\nstdout_logfile=/dev/fd/2\\nstdout_logfile_maxbytes=0\\nstderr_logfile=/dev/fd/2\\nstderr_logfile_maxbytes=0\\n\\n[program:nginx]\\ncommand=nginx -g \\\"daemon off;\\\"\\nautostart=true\\nautorestart=true\\nstdout_logfile=/dev/fd/1\\nstdout_logfile_maxbytes=0\\nstderr_logfile=/dev/fd/2\\nstderr_logfile_maxbytes=0\\nserver {\\r\\n    listen 80;\\r\\n    server_name _;\\r\\n    root /app/public;\\r\\n    index index.php;\\r\\n\\r\\n    # Security headers\\r\\n    add_header X-Frame-Options \\\"SAMEORIGIN\\\" always;\\r\\n    add_header X-Content-Type-Options \\\"nosniff\\\" always;\\r\\n    add_header X-XSS-Protection \\\"1; mode=block\\\" always;\\r\\n    add_header Referrer-Policy \\\"strict-origin-when-cross-origin\\\" always;\\r\\n    add_header Strict-Transport-Security \\\"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains\\\" always;\\r\\n\\r\\n    # Gzip\\r\\n    gzip on;\\r\\n    gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript application/manifest+json text/xml application/xml image/svg+xml;\\r\\n    gzip_min_length 256;\\r\\n\\r\\n    # PWA: service worker must be revalidated (never long-cached) or\\r\\n    # browsers will not pick up updates. The manifest needs the correct\\r\\n    # MIME type or Chrome will not treat it as a web app manifest.\\r\\n    location = /sw.js {\\r\\n        default_type text/javascript;\\r\\n        add_header Cache-Control \\\"no-cache\\\";\\r\\n        add_header X-Content-Type-Options \\\"nosniff\\\" always;\\r\\n        try_files $uri =404;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    location ~* \\\\.(webmanifest)$ {\\r\\n        default_type application/manifest+json;\\r\\n        add_header Cache-Control \\\"no-cache\\\";\\r\\n        add_header X-Content-Type-Options \\\"nosniff\\\" always;\\r\\n        try_files $uri =404;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    # Static assets: long cache\\r\\n    location ~* \\\\.(css|js|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|ico|svg|woff|woff2|ttf|eot)$ {\\r\\n        expires 30d;\\r\\n        add_header Cache-Control \\\"public, immutable\\\";\\r\\n        try_files $uri =404;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    # PHP front controller\\r\\n    location / {\\r\\n        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$query_string;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    location ~ \\\\.php$ {\\r\\n        fastcgi_pass 127.0.0.1:9000;\\r\\n        fastcgi_index index.php;\\r\\n        fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME $document_root$fastcgi_script_name;\\r\\n        include fastcgi_params;\\r\\n        # TLS is terminated by the Dokploy reverse proxy, which forwards\\r\\n        # X-Forwarded-Proto. Map that to PHP's HTTPS flag so the app can\\r\\n        # build correct canonical URLs (webhook signature validation needs\\r\\n        # the https scheme to match Twilio's configured webhook URL).\\r\\n        set $pp_https off;\\r\\n        if ($http_x_forwarded_proto = 'https') { set $pp_https on; }\\r\\n        fastcgi_param HTTPS $pp_https;\\r\\n        fastcgi_read_timeout 60s;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    # Block dotfiles\\r\\n    location ~ /\\\\. {\\r\\n        deny all;\\r\\n        access_log off;\\r\\n        log_not_found off;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    # Block direct access to sensitive dirs\\r\\n    location ~ ^/(app|config|database|storage|templates|bin|vendor)/ {\\r\\n        deny all;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log;\\r\\n    error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\",\n  \"original_output_bytes\": 5674,\n  \"original_output_tokens\": 1419,\n  \"truncated\": false\n}",

      "envelope": {

        "id": "afa3f498-29e5-43ae-b1e6-150193654de2",
        "payload": {
          "event": {
            "kind": "assistant_message_committed",
            "message_id": "10e6b812-e21f-4802-a0a2-2d3e602fda87",
            "provider_item_id": "msg_[redacted]",
            "response_id": "resp_6a7e214a908b54e0c5ee4553",
            "text": "## Codebase Review — `patriot-pest-demo` (`/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app`)\n\nLocal clone of `David2024patton/patriot-pest-demo` (~7650 LOC PHP, SQLite, Docker/nginx+php-fpm). Single entry point `public/index.php` → `app/bootstrap.php` → `Router::dispatch()`. PSR-4 `PPC\\` → `app/`. 3 test files.\n\n### Architecture — Grade B+\n\n**Good skeleton:** Explicit route map in `public/index.php:68-238` is the best decision in the repo — old `.htaccess` spaghetti replaced with one readable table, guards chained as `->auth('staff')->role('admin')->permission(...)`. `Database` is the only DB surface (`Database::fetch/fetchAll/execute/insert` all via prepared statements), `bootstrap.php` installs sane error handlers (no stack traces in prod). `Dockerfile` is minimal alpine `php:8.3-fpm + nginx + supervisor` with `opcache`.\n\n**Flow:** Marketing pages public → pest/area/blog DB-driven → unified passwordless OTP login (`AuthController:41-230` + `OtpAuth`) → customer/staff/admin dashboards → `/api/v1/*` (Bearer `ppc_live_*` via `ApiAuth`) + Twilio/Facebook webhooks (HMAC-verified) + retention beacons.\n\n### What Is Well Done\n\n* **Auth hardening:** `Session.php:28-58` sets `use_strict_mode=1`, `httponly`, `samesite=Lax`, `secure` on HTTPS, `sid_length=48`, regenerates on privilege bump. `OtpAuth.php:48-122` hashes codes with `password_hash`, single-use (`used_at`), expiry (`OTP_TTL`/`SU_OTP_TTL`), per-identity `RateLimiter` + `RateLimiter::tooMany(\"otp:$purpose:$identity\")`. Super-user isolated to `/su` (`AuthController:293-299` + `public/index.php:178-183`).\n* **API auth:** `ApiAuth.php:60-76` stores only `sha256(key_hash)`, constant-time `hash_equals`, checks `revoked_at`/`expires_at`, scope gate (`customer:read` etc.), audit log + dummy hash on miss (no timing leak). `createKey`/`rotateKey` are transactional.\n* **CSRF:** `Csrf.php:30-92` per-session `random_bytes(32)`, `hash_equals` check, `fromRequest()` accepts POST field or `X-CSRF-Token` header, `verifyOrDie()` → 419. Correctly exempted for webhooks/beacons.\n* **Compliance gate:** `Compliance.php` central DNC/is_no_call/unsubscribes check before any SMS/email — required for TCPA.\n* **Secrets handling:** `.env` git-ignored correctly (`.gitignore:7`), `Config` parser, `APP_KEY` signing for unsubscribe tokens, `openapi.yaml` documents `BearerAuth` scopes.\n\n### Findings\n\n**High**\n\n1. **Dockerfile `chmod 777` — over-permissive** `[Dockerfile:14]`\n   ```dockerfile\n   chmod -R 777 storage database\n   ```\n   Allows any container user to overwrite SQLite DB/logs. Would change to `770` + `chown ppc:www-data` and run php-fpm as `ppc`. Affects persistence and PII exposure if container is compromised.\n\n2. **`Database::insert/update` interpolates table/column names** `[Database.php:286,295]`\n   ```php\n   \"INSERT INTO $table ...\"; \"UPDATE $table SET $set ...\"\n   ```\n   Values are bound, but identifiers are not escaped/allow-listed. Safe today because callers are internal, but one future caller passing user input as table name = SQL injection. Would add allow-list or backtick-escaping and assert.\n\n3. **Rate limiter fails open** `[RateLimiter.php:76-92, Database.php usage]`\n   `hit()`/`tooMany()` catch `Throwable` and continue. If SQLite is locked/corrupt, brute-force protection silently disappears. Would make `tooMany()` fail closed (return `true` on DB error) for auth paths.\n\n4. **`Session::enforceIdleTimeout` destroys then re-starts session mid-request** `[Session.php:78-81]`\n   `destroy()` + `start()` issues a new cookie but the current request still runs with `$_SESSION` empty — guard checks after this point can behave inconsistently. Would redirect to `/login` instead of transparently restarting.\n\n**Medium**\n\n5. **SQLite time vs PHP time drift** `[OtpAuth.php:47,96]` — `used_at = datetime('now')` (SQLite UTC) vs `expires_at = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time()+ttl)` (PHP timezone). Can cause 1s–60s window where code appears valid/invalid depending on container TZ. Would use PHP time for both.\n\n6. **Compliance phone matching with `LIKE '%digits'`** `[Compliance.php:??]` — trailing LIKE can match wrong customer (e.g. `5551234` matches `15551234` and `25551234`). OK as defensive legacy, but would tighten to canonical E.164 after FieldRoutes sync normalizes.\n\n7. **Router pattern not escaped** `[Router.php:87-92]` — `preg_replace` builds regex from `$pattern` without `preg_quote` on literal segments. Safe now (patterns are code literals), but a pattern containing `.` or `+` would mis-match. Would quote literals.\n\n8. **No `PUT/PATCH/DELETE` verbs, no method override** — API is read-only GET, admin forms use POST for updates/deletes (semantic mismatch, but intentional for CSRF simplicity — document it).\n\n9. **Test coverage thin:** Only `tests/PartETest.php`, `RouteRegistrationTest.php`, `SuperuserTest.php` — no tests for `ApiAuth`, `Compliance`, `RateLimiter`, `OtpAuth` timing, webhook HMAC, or Facebook `fingerprint` dedup. `phpunit` not runnable in current sandbox (no `php` binary).\n\n**Low / Hygiene**\n\n10. `app/Auth/OtpAuth.php.bak` committed — stray backup file.\n11. `public/cost/*` + `public/*.zip` tarballs (`cost_*.zip`, 10+ archives) — should be git-ignored, bloat history (`.gitignore:35` ignores `*.zip` now but old ones remain in history).\n12. `App\\Core\\Config::bool()` used for `SUPERUSER_ENABLED`/`API_ENABLED` toggles without cache — re-reads env each dispatch; negligible.\n13. `View::render('errors/403')` in `Router::enforceGuards` assumes template exists — no fallback if missing.\n14. `Mailer.php` logs to `storage/logs/mail-*.log` in debug — ensure log rotation (PII).\n\n**Security Positives Verified**\n\n* `.env` not committed, `database/*.db` ignored, `openapi.yaml` does not leak secrets.\n* `Session` fixation defense, `Csrf` constant-time, `ApiAuth` hash-equals, OTP single-use — all implemented as documented.\n\n### Exact Changes I Would Make (not applied — reporting only)\n\n* `[Dockerfile:14]` `chmod 777` → `chown ppc:ppc storage database && chmod 770 storage database`\n* `[Database.php:282-300]` Add `private const ALLOWED_TABLES` + `assertTable($table)` and backtick identifiers\n* `[RateLimiter.php:25]` `tooMany()` → return `true` on `catch (Throwable)` for auth callers; add `failClosed` param\n* `[Session.php:78]` Replace destroy+restart with `destroy(); header('Location: /login'); exit;`\n* `[OtpAuth.php:47]` Use PHP `gmdate` for `used_at` to match `expires_at`\n\nIf you want me to apply these, say which ones and I'll implement + verify with the project's own tests (`phpunit`) and a syntax check once `php` is available. I did not modify any files for this review.\n\nWant a deeper dive on a specific area (e.g., `FieldRoutes` sync, `Twilio` signature validation, or the Facebook lead → `vtext.com` SMS pipeline)?\n"
          },

            "text": "# Patriot Pest App — Parallel Code Review\n\n**Overall Architecture Grade: B (Strong foundation, needs hardening before production scale)**\n\n**Stack:** `PHP 8.3 + SQLite (WAL)` · `nginx/php-fpm` (supervisord) · PSR-4 `PPC\\→app/` · Front-controller `public/index.php` · `Router` with `->auth()`/`->role()`/`->permission()` guards · No framework/ORM. Two DBs: `database/patriot.db` (app) + `storage/retention.sqlite` (analytics).\n\n**Strengths:** Single prepared-statement layer (`Database`), centralized `Compliance::isBlocked()` DNC gate, `Csrf` + `RateLimiter`, passwordless OTP (`password_hash`), API keys (`SHA-256 + hash_equals`), separate retention DB, `View` escaping via `e()`, route-registration smoke test.\n\n**Top Risks:** World-writable volumes (`chmod 777`), `X-Forwarded-For` trusted unconditionally (rate-limit / audit spoof), retention beacons + FB webhooks un-rate-limited, `FieldRoutes` credentials in query-string (logged), inconsistent interpolation of `LIMIT/OFFSET`, STARTTLS/SMTP without cert verification.\n\n---\n\n## `app/Core`\n\n| File | Purpose | Key Findings |\n|---|---|---|\n| [`ApiAuth.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/ApiAuth.php:1) | Bearer `ppc_live_<64hex>` auth, `key_prefix→key_hash` SHA-256 + `hash_equals`, scope + revocation/expiry, audit | **Good:** dummy `hash_equals` on miss (timing), constant-time scope `all`, `last_used_at` best-effort. **Issue:** `requireAuth()` caches `keyRow` and early-returns `if hasScopes()` — bypasses `API_ENABLED` toggle + re-checks of `revoked_at`/`expires_at` for cached hit (minor, same request). `fail()` calls `exit` → untestable; should throw. No per-key revocation propagation within request. |\n| [`Compliance.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Compliance.php:1) | DNC gate (`customers.is_no_call` + `unsubscribes`), `recordUnsubscribe`, HMAC unsubscribe tokens | **Good:** multi-form phone matching (`raw/digits/+1/LIKE %national`), `COLLATE NOCASE` email, audit on unsubscribe. **Issues:** `hmacKey()` falls back to `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN` when `APP_KEY` missing — silent key downgrade. `isBlocked()` silently coerces unknown channel→`sms` (fail-open hides bugs). Token TTL 90 d default too long for signed unsubscribe link. |\n| [`Config.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Config.php:1) | `.env` loader, `get/int/bool`, quoted-value parsing, `getenv()` override | Solid 12-factor: `getenv` precedence, single-load guard. **Nit:** inline-comment regex `^([^#]*?)\\s+#` strips values containing ` #` without comment intent; `;`-comments only at line start. |\n| [`Csrf.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Csrf.php:1) | Per-session token (`random_bytes(32)`), `field()`, `check()` `hash_equals`, `verifyOrDie()` | Good 64-hex token, header + field. **Issue:** `verifyOrDie()` always emits JSON `419` — form POSTs expect redirect/flash. No per-route enforcement (relies on controllers remembering to call it). |\n| [`Database.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Database.php:1) | Singleton PDO SQLite WAL, `PRAGMA foreign_keys/busy_timeout`, `fetch/fetchAll/scalar/insert/update/begin/commit/rollback`, schema migrator | **Good:** `ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES=false`, all queries parametrized, idempotent `schema.sql` + versioned `upgrade()`. **Issues:** `insert/update` interpolate table/col names without backticks (code-controlled → OK but fragile if reused); `upgrade()` swallows all `ALTER`/`INDEX` errors silently; directory `mkdir 0775` but Dockerfile later does `777`. `open()` for retention correctly avoids app migration. |\n| [`Geo.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Geo.php:1) | Region (`wa`/`az`) → phone display, session → `GEO_FORCE_REGION` → disk cache (7 d) → `ip-api.com` lookup | Fail-open correct. **Issues:** live lookup over `http://` (MITM downgrade), `md5(ip).json` cache without locking race, no validation of `ip-api.com` response beyond `status==success`. |\n| [`Logger.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Logger.php:1) | Daily `storage/logs/YYYY-MM-DD.log`, `encode()` redacts `pass|token|secret|code|key|sid` | Good log format + redaction. **Issues:** no rotation/size cap, raw `date('c')` + file I/O can fail silently; `encode` regex can over-redact legitimate keys (e.g. `monkey`). |\n| [`RateLimiter.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/RateLimiter.php:1) | Sliding window via `login_attempts`, `clientIp()` (XFF leftmost), `hit/clear/retryAfter/checkOrDie` | Correct window semantics. **Critical:** `clientIp()` trusts `X-Forwarded-For` unconditionally — attacker can spoof to shard/bypass per-IP limits and pollute audits unless behind trusted proxy that overwrites it. `checkOrDie` does `hit()` then `tooMany()` — counts current attempt as failure even on success paths. |\n| [`Retention.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Retention.php:1) | Analytics store `storage/retention.sqlite`, `recordView/Event/SessionEnd`, `summary()` (14 d) | **Good:** separate DB, `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE`, `FILTER (WHERE)` queries. **Issues:** `view_order = COUNT(*)+1` race without TX; `summary()` uses named params `:from` but passes `['from'=>]` (PDO mapping works on most drivers but brittle); `click_path` view uses `row_number() OVER` requires SQLite ≥3.44 — verify base image version. Bounce = 1 view + <10 s heuristic is narrow. |\n| [`Router.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Router.php:1) | `GET/POST` regex, `{param}` → `(?P<name>[^/]+)`, `->auth()->role()->permission()`, `dispatch()` | Clean. **Issues:** no `PUT/DELETE` support, no CSRF enforcement at router, missing path-traversal sanitization in handlers not needed yet but `View` also not hardened (see `View`). `rtrim()` normalization double-handles `//`. Permission checks call `Session::hasPermission()` → DB per request (could cache). |\n| [`Session.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Session.php:1) | Hardened session: `use_strict_mode`, `httponly`, `SameSite=Lax`, `cookie_secure` on HTTPS, idle timeouts, `regenerate()` | Good fixation defense + per-role TTLs (`super-user` 3600 s). **Nit:** `enforceIdleTimeout()` does `destroy(); start();` then caller still touches `_last_activity` — OK but re-entrant. `hasPermission()` DB hit per check, returns false on exception (fail-closed correct). |\n| [`Settings.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Settings.php:1) | `site_settings` `bool()/set()`, per-request cache | Correct caching, `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE`. No validation of `key` values. |\n| [`Validator.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/Validator.php:1) | `make(['required','email','phone','numeric','len','min','max','in','url'])` | Minimal. **Issues:** single error per field (hides secondary errors), `in:` split on `,` — values containing commas break; `phone` uses 7-15 digits heuristic OK; no escaping of LIKE wildcards (see controllers). |\n| [`View.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Core/View.php:1) | `render()/page()`, anonymous `$view` helper (`e/raw/asset/url/csrf/phone/authed`), layout detection | Good `EXTR_SKIP` + output buffering + `e()` default. **Issues:** template path `str_replace('/',DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR,$template).'.php'` not sanitized for `..` traversal — currently safe (hardcoded strings) but insecure if exposed to user input. `detectLayout()` regex may misclassify future paths. |\n\n## `app/Controllers`\n\n| File | Purpose | Key Findings |\n|---|---|---|\n| [`AdminController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/AdminController.php:1) | CMS: posts/media/content/retention/settings | CSRF + `Validator` + `audit()` everywhere good. `sanitizeRich()` strips `script/style/iframe/on*=javascript:` but still allows `src=javascript:` on `<img>` and `data:` URLs — use allowlist HTML purifier. `uniqueSlug()` loop unbounded under collision flood. |\n| [`ApiController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/ApiController.php:1) | `/api/v1/*` (health/customers/tickets/messages/services/twilio/logs/staff), dual rate limit, PII redaction | **Good:** IP-limit before auth + key-limit after, scope `customer:read-full` gates PII. **Nits:** pagination `LIMIT $n OFFSET $o` interpolated (int-cast → safe but inconsistent style); `customers` `LIKE %q%` without escaping `%/_`; `twilioColumnList()` match is correct whitelist. `health()` correctly unauthenticated. |\n| [`ApiKeyController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/ApiKeyController.php:1) | `index/create/revoke/rotate/updateScopes/audit`, CSRF, lifecycle `audit_log` | Good rotate in TX. **Issue:** `updateScopes` comma-split scopes without whitelist validation — can persist arbitrary scope strings. `audit` LIKE `%\"prefix\":\"..\"%` uses `?` param correctly but hex filter `^[a-f0-9]{12}$` is strict — OK. `rotate` shows new key once — good. |\n| [`AuthController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/AuthController.php:1) | Unified passwordless `/login` + elevated `/su`, dual-defense super-user exclusion, OTP mail, audit | **Excellent:** `findStaffForLogin` excludes `super-user`, `startStaffSession` throws if super-user reaches standard flow, per-IP + per-identity OTP limits, `Session::regenerate()`, enumeration defense. **Nits:** customer lookup `email= ? OR phone= ? OR account_number= ?` uses exact phone — misses normalized `+1` case (Compliance logic not reused). Customer phone/account login requires non-empty email to actually send code — confusing UX. `maskEmail` leaks local-part length. |\n| [`BlogController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/BlogController.php:1) | `index/show/rss` unified template | `UPDATE posts SET views=views+1` best-effort good. Related via `season OR pest_category` OK. No issues. |\n| [`PageController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/PageController.php:1) | Marketing pages + `ldBusiness()` JSON-LD | `meta()` hardcodes `https://patriotpest.pro` for canonical — diverges from `APP_URL` (staging wrong). `threat board` DB-driven good. `contactSubmit` TODO notify not wired — but logs. |\n| [`PestController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/PestController.php:1) | `/pest/{slug}` DB-driven | Clean, correct 6-related by `category`. |\n| [`PortalController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/PortalController.php:1) | Customer portal: tickets/messages/appointments/subscriptions/billing + live FR pull | Good degrade to local cache on FR failure. **Issues:** `to_user = ? OR from_user = ?` messages fetch uses `customerId` as TEXT — OK, but 5 separate sequential queries (no N+1 loop). |\n| [`RetentionController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/RetentionController.php:1) | Beacons `view/event/session_end` (204, CSRF-exempt), `summary` 401 for non-admin | Same-origin check via `parse_url` host equality correct. **Issues:** if `Origin` empty check skipped — curl can spam `storage/retention.sqlite`; no rate limit on ingestion → disk-fill DOS. |\n| [`StaffController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/StaffController.php:1) | Staff dashboard, customer book/search/sync, staff CRUD | **Good:** `isStaffDeactivatable` seam protects super-user, search `q` min-length 2, sync cooldown 60 s via `meta.fr_last_sync`, per-district try/catch. **Issues:** all search `LIKE %q%` without escaping `%/_`; pagination `page` not clamped to 1 in Twilio search sibling but `customers()` clamps; `staffList` exposes super-user rows. |\n| [`TwilioController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/TwilioController.php:1) | Admin SMS/calls/voicemail/webhooks | Correct CSRF. **Bugs:** `page = (int)($_GET['page'] ??1)` allows `0` → `OFFSET -50`; `LIMIT $limit OFFSET $offset` interpolated (safe int but brittle). |\n| [`WebhookController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Controllers/WebhookController.php:1) | Twilio `X-Twilio-Signature` validation, STOP/START, unsubscribe `token` | **Good:** HMAC-SHA256 URL+sortedParams, `handleIncomingSms` logs + `processPendingWebhooks`, branded unsubscribe HTML. **Issues:** `clearStopOptOut` exact `phone = ?` match misses legacy formats (Compliance multi-form not reused); STOP `reason LIKE '%STOP%'` is loose. |\n\n## `app/Auth`\n\n| File | Findings |\n|---|---|\n| [`Mailer.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Auth/Mailer.php:1) | Dev log gated by `Config::isLocal()` (correct). **Security:** SMTP headers interpolate `$from/$to/$subject` without CRLF stripping → header injection if subject ever becomes user-controlled. `AUTH LOGIN` sends creds without verifying server `334` responses — blind but works. |\n| [`OtpAuth.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Auth/OtpAuth.php:1) | **Excellent:** prior codes invalidated, `random_int` uniform, `password_hash`, `password_verify`, purpose-aware `ttlFor/maxAttemptsFor` (`super-login` 300 s/3 vs `login` 600 s/5), `RateLimiter` integration, `retryAfter`. **Nit:** `verify()` does `RateLimiter::hit(success=true)` audit record on success — extra row intentionally. |\n\n## `app/Integrations`\n\n| File | Findings |\n|---|---|\n| [`FieldRoutes.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Integrations/FieldRoutes.php:1) | Multi-district `isConfigured()/missingDistricts()`, `pullCustomersForDistrict` (batch 200), `normalizePhone()` E.164 robust, `upsertCustomer()` preserves `is_no_call/dnc_reason`. **Critical:** `request()` puts `authenticationKey/Token` in URL query — leaks in nginx access logs + `file_get_contents` URL. Should move to header or redact logs. `cacheAppointment/Subscription` check-then-insert lacks UNIQUE constraint — concurrent sync can duplicate. `fmtDate` `strtotime` loose parsing. |\n| [`Twilio.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Integrations/Twilio.php:1) | Full SMS/voice/voicemail/webhook, DNC gate via `Compliance::isBlocked('sms',null,to)` shared, audit `sms.dnc_blocked/voice.dnc_blocked`, `processPendingWebhooks()` 50 at a time. **Issues:** `isConfigured()` only checks SID+token, not `phoneNumber` (send then fails). `getSmsLogs/getCallLogs/...` use interpolated `LIMIT` (safe but style risk). `TWILIO_SSL_VERIFY` false allows downgrade. Media URL stored raw. |\n\n## `app/Services/Sms` / Webhooks / Models\n\n| File | Findings |\n|---|---|\n| [`SmsService.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Services/Sms/SmsService.php:1) | Lead pipeline via Titan `smtp.titan.email:587` STARTTLS → `LEAD_SMS_TO` (`5096664121@vtext.com`), email fallback to `LEAD_EMAIL_TO`. Gated by `LEAD_SMS_ENABLED` (misnamed in comment as `SMS_ENABLED`). **Issues:** STARTTLS `stream_socket_enable_crypto` without peer verification → MITM. Credentials `LEAD_SMTP_*` in clear. No DNC check on lead phone (intentional `LEAD_SMS_BYPASS_DNC=true` default — compliance question). |\n| [`FacebookWebhookController.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Webhooks/Facebook/FacebookWebhookController.php:1) | `GET verify` (`hub.mode`→`hub_mode` PHP conversion handled), `POST receive` → `X-Hub-Signature-256` `hash_equals`, Graph `GET /v21.0/{leadgen_id}`, dedup `leadgen_id UNIQUE + fingerprint 24h`. **Issues:** `fingerprint = SHA256(name\\|email\\|phone)` case-sensitive (no lower/normalize). `hub_challenge` echoed raw without type check (could echo huge string). `fetchLeadFromGraph` curl no SSL verify toggle. No webhook rate limiting. |\n| [`FacebookLead.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/Models/FacebookLead.php:1) | Thin model: `findByLeadgenId`, `fingerprintExists`, `insert`, `updateNotificationStatus`. Clean. |\n| [`public/index.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/public/index.php:1) | `cost` modular early exit, production HTTPS force (trusts `X-Forwarded-Proto`), conditional `SUPERUSER_ENABLED` + `API_ENABLED` route registration. **Nits:** `$_SERVER['HTTP_HOST']` used in redirect without validation (open-redirect if Host injected behind proxy not stripping). |\n| [`public/router.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/public/router.php:1) | Built-in server static-file short-circuit, subdomain `cost.` routing. **Nits:** `strpos($host,'cost.')!==false` matches `evilcost.` |\n| [`app/bootstrap.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/app/bootstrap.php:1) | `BASE_PATH`, `Config::load`, PSR-4, `Logger::setDir`, error handlers (debug-only trace), `Session::start()`. Correct `PPC_ROUTES_ONLY` bypass for tests. |\n\n## `tests` / DB / Config / Infra\n\n| File | Findings |\n|---|---|\n| [`tests/*.php`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/tests/PartETest.php:1) | `PartETest` 17 trivial assertions (hash shape, scope denial) — not integration; `SuperuserTest` thorough (OTP TTL/attempts, `findStaffForLogin` exclusion, `startStaffSession` throws, seed idempotency, toggle, routes, `isStaffDeactivatable`); `RouteRegistrationTest` excellent — catches `use` import defects by forcing `API_ENABLED=true` + `SUPERUSER_ENABLED=true` + `APP_ENV=local` and checking every `[Class,method]` resolves. `tests/bootstrap.php` correctly defines `BASE_PATH`. |\n| [`database/schema.sql`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/database/schema.sql:1) | 570 l, idempotent `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, correct `COLLATE NOCASE` email, seeded roles `super-user/admin/...`. **Gaps:** `customers` not UNIQUE on `(fr_id,district)` → duplicate cache rows under race; `api_keys.key_hash` unindexed (lookup by `key_prefix` only → fine). |\n| [`database/retention.sql`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/database/retention.sql:1) | Mirror of `RETENTION_SCHEMA.sql`, `click_path` view with `row_number() OVER` + `group_concat`. Requires SQLite ≥3.44. |\n| [`.env.example`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/.env.example:1) | 124 l, documents all toggles; reveals `SU_SEED_EMAIL=david@itak.live` + `GADS_ID` placeholder. |\n| [`openapi.yaml`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/openapi.yaml:1) | Accurate for `/api/v1/{health,customers,customers/{id},tickets,messages,services,twilio/logs,staff}`; correctly documents `customer:read-full` field withholding, but incomplete (no `twilio:read` body fields in full-detail). |\n| [`Dockerfile`](/mnt/g/Mojo/patriot-pest-app/Dockerfile:1) | `php:8.3-fpm-alpine` + `nginx` + `supervisord`, `opcache`, healthcheck `wget /health`. **Critical:** `chmod -R 777 storage database` (and `entrypoint.sh` reapplies) — world-writable; should be `775` + `chown www-data`. `COPY . .` may include `.env` if not in `.dockerignore`. `HSTS` always set even when terminated TLS not present. |\n\n---\n\n### Top Remediation Priority\n\n1. **Permissions:** `777` → `775` + correct group; add `.env` to `.dockerignore`.\n2. **Trust proxy correctly:** Gate `RateLimiter::clientIp()` + `ApiAuth` audit + `X-Forwarded-Proto` on a `TRUSTED_PROXY=true` flag; otherwise use `REMOTE_ADDR`.\n3. **Rate-limit ingestion:** Add sliding-window limit to `RetentionController::track()` and FB `receive()` (even behind signature).\n4. **SQL pattern consistency:** Bind `LIMIT/OFFSET` via params or strict int clamp (`max(1, page)`) everywhere; escape `LIKE` `%/_` via `ESCAPE '\\'`.\n5. **Secrets hygiene:** Move FieldRoutes auth off query-string; redact URLs in nginx logs; add CRLF stripping in `Mailer`.\n6. **TLS verification:** Verify peer after STARTTLS (`SmsService`) and Twilio/Graph cURL calls; don't silently allow `*_SSL_VERIFY=false` in production.\n\n"
